name: Donor Posts Surplus Food in Under a Minute
description: A caterer manager signs in, describes surplus in free text, has the AI parse it, confirms the fields and sees the listing reach Posted with its handling card.

steps.description: Caterer manager signs in using the role switcher and selects the donor role.

business_rules.name: demo_role_switcher_establishes_session
business_rules.description: In the MVP, choosing a role in the role switcher signs the user in as the seeded synthetic User for that role, with no password or real account.
triggers: Caterer manager opens the app and uses the role switcher on the login page
Caterer manager selects the donor role
side_effects: User.role is set to donor for the session
the app opens the donor posting view for that User
error_handling: If no seeded User exists for the selected role, the login is refused and the user is told the demo account is unavailable; the seed-reset script is the fix
If the role value is not one of the four known roles, nothing is signed in

business_rules.name: donor_sign_in_does_not_grant_posting
business_rules.description: Signing in as donor does not by itself allow posting; the linked Donor must have a verified FSSAI licence or registration number, and that check happens when the donor posts.
triggers: Caterer manager selects the donor role and is signed in
Donor later attempts to post a listing
side_effects: the donor session is created whether or not the linked Donor is verified
the posting view shows a blocking message if Donor.fssai_verified is false
error_handling: If the linked Donor is unverified, expired or mismatched, the login still succeeds but posting is blocked with the reason shown
If the User has no linked Donor, the donor view is shown with no posting access and an explanation

business_rules.name: login_uses_synthetic_users_only
business_rules.description: All users available at login are synthetic and generated, with no real names, addresses or personal contact details stored on the User record.
triggers: Seed script or demo data generator creates the User records used by the role switcher
side_effects: the role switcher lists only generated names
error_handling: If a real-looking name or personal detail is found in seeded users, the seed run is rejected and the data is regenerated

validation_rules.description: A role must be selected in the role switcher before the user can continue.
validation_rules.error_message: Choose a role to continue.

validation_rules.description: The role must be one of the four known roles: donor, receiver, volunteer or sponsor, with admin reserved for the platform administrator.
validation_rules.error_message: That role is not available. Choose donor, receiver, volunteer or sponsor.

steps.description: Home shows the caterer's next action: start a new post.

business_rules.name: only_fssai_verified_donors_can_start_a_post
business_rules.description: A caterer sees the start-a-new-post action on the home screen only when their Donor record has a verified, unexpired FSSAI licence or registration number that matches the account.
triggers: Caterer manager opens the home screen
Caterer manager taps the start-a-new-post action
Donor's FSSAI status changes (verified, expired, or mismatched)
side_effects: Donor.verification_status is checked before the post action is shown as enabled
Home shows the start-a-new-post action as enabled for a verified donor
Home shows the start-a-new-post action as blocked, with the reason, for an unverified, expired or mismatched donor
error_handling: Donor.verification_status is unverified: post action is blocked and the donor is told the licence has not been verified
Donor.fssai_expires_at has passed: post action is blocked the same day and the donor is told the licence has expired
Licence name or address does not match the donor account: post action is blocked and the donor is told the details do not match
Donor.fssai_number is missing: post action is blocked and the donor is asked to add a licence number

business_rules.name: donor_zone_must_be_a_launch_zone_to_post
business_rules.description: A caterer can start a new post only when the Donor record's zone is one of the eight launch zones (Patia, Chandrasekharpur, Saheed Nagar, Nayapalli, Jaydev Vihar, Khandagiri, Old Town, Rasulgarh).
triggers: Caterer manager opens the home screen
Caterer manager taps the start-a-new-post action
side_effects: Home shows the start-a-new-post action as enabled for a donor in a launch zone
Home shows the start-a-new-post action as blocked, with a clear message, for a donor outside the launch zones
error_handling: Donor.zone is not one of the eight launch zones: posting is blocked and the donor is told posting is not yet available in their area
Donor.zone is missing: the donor is asked to set their zone before posting

steps.description: Donor types what food, how much and the pickup-by time, then submits the text.

business_rules.name: donor_confirms_listing_before_posting
business_rules.description: A listing moves from draft to Posted only after the donor has reviewed and confirmed the items, quantity and pickup-by time, so AI output never goes live unchecked.
triggers: Donor taps Confirm on the listing review screen after typing or submitting the post text
side_effects: Listing.status becomes Posted
A StatusEvent is logged with the donor as actor and the time of confirmation
The donor sees the listing as posted and the matching process starts
error_handling: Donor has not confirmed: Listing stays unposted and nothing is offered to receivers
Donor edits a field after AI extraction: the edited values replace the AI-filled values before confirmation

business_rules.name: ai_extraction_drafts_listing_fields_only
business_rules.description: The anthropic model parses the donor's typed or spoken post into items, quantities, units and a pickup-by time as a draft, and never invents a quantity, time or allergen that the text does not contain.
triggers: Donor submits the free-text post
Donor submits a post with a missing pickup-by time or quantity
side_effects: Extracted fields are shown to the donor marked AI-filled with the source words highlighted
Allergens with no evidence in the text are set to unknown, ask donor
The AI call and its inputs and outputs are logged
error_handling: Pickup-by time missing: the AI asks exactly one follow-up question about it
Quantity or time not stated: the field is left empty rather than guessed
Output contains a banned claim, such as safe or certified, or an injected instruction: output is discarded, the case is logged for admin, and the plain form is used
AI is slow over 5 s or returns invalid output after one retry: donor is shown the plain 3-field form

business_rules.name: posting_never_depends_on_ai
business_rules.description: A donor can always post through the plain form (items, quantity and pickup-by) even when the AI is unavailable, with no AI call needed.
triggers: AI call times out after 5 s
AI returns invalid output after one retry
Donor chooses the plain form directly
side_effects: The 3-field form is displayed in place of the AI-filled review
Listing is created from the form values and can reach Posted after confirmation
error_handling: AI down: donor sees the plain 3-field form with no error message about the AI
Form values missing: the plain form marks the missing field required and does not post

business_rules.name: unlicensed_donor_cannot_post
business_rules.description: Only donors with a verified, unexpired FSSAI licence or registration number can create a listing, and an unverified, expired or mismatched number blocks posting with a stated reason.
triggers: Donor opens the post form
Donor submits the post text or confirms a listing
side_effects: Listing is not created and nothing is parsed or offered
Donor is shown the blocking reason and told how to fix it
error_handling: FSSAI number unverified (mocked check in demo): posting is blocked with the reason
FSSAI number expired: posting is blocked the same day with the reason
No FSSAI number on the account: posting is blocked before the AI is called

business_rules.name: donor_must_be_in_launch_zone
business_rules.description: A donor whose zone is outside the 8 launch zones (Patia, Chandrasekharpur, Saheed Nagar, Nayapalli, Jaydev Vihar, Khandagiri, Old Town, Rasulgarh) cannot post a listing.
triggers: Donor opens the post form
Donor submits the post text or confirms a listing
side_effects: Listing is not created
Donor is told posting is not yet open in their area
error_handling: Zone not in the 8 launch zones: posting is blocked with a clear message

business_rules.name: pickup_by_must_allow_time_to_rescue
business_rules.description: A listing whose pickup-by time has passed or is less than 30 minutes away is marked unrescuable with a reason and is never offered to receivers.
triggers: Donor confirms a listing with a pickup-by time
Time passes before a listing is offered
side_effects: Listing.rescuable_reason records why the food cannot be rescued
The donor is told the listing cannot be offered and why
Listing is not matched or offered
error_handling: Pickup-by in the past at posting: listing marked unrescuable and donor is told
Pickup-by under 30 minutes away: listing marked unrescuable and donor is told

business_rules.name: consume_by_is_earliest_of_pickup_and_rule_limit
business_rules.description: The consume-by deadline is the earlier of the donor's pickup-by time and the food-handling rule-table limit for that food type and storage, and it is shown on every screen.
triggers: Donor confirms a listing
Listing items or pickup-by time change after posting
side_effects: Listing.consume_by is set and displayed on the handling card
The rule-table version used is recorded on the listing
error_handling: No rule matches the food type: the most conservative limit is applied and labelled as such
Computed deadline earlier than the pickup-by time: the earlier value is kept and shown

business_rules.name: handling_card_required_before_posted
business_rules.description: No listing can reach Posted without a complete handling card: consume-by time, storage guidance, allergen tags and the fixed disclaimer "Not certified safe — follow handling guidance".
triggers: Donor confirms a listing
System attaches handling information to a listing
side_effects: Listing.disclaimer is set to the fixed text and cannot be edited
Listing.allergens shows unknown, ask donor where not confirmed
Listing.status becomes Posted only when all four parts are present
error_handling: Any handling card part missing: posting is blocked and the donor is told which part is missing
Disclaimer text altered: posting is blocked

business_rules.name: duplicate_post_requires_donor_confirmation
business_rules.description: A new post from the same donor with the same items within 10 minutes of an earlier post requires the donor to confirm before a second listing is created.
triggers: Donor submits a post whose items match a listing created by the same donor in the last 10 minutes
side_effects: Second listing is held until the donor confirms it is not a duplicate
If the donor confirms, a separate listing is created; otherwise nothing is created
error_handling: Donor cancels the duplicate prompt: no second listing is created
Donor confirms the duplicate: second listing is created and posted

validation_rules.description: The food items field must contain at least one item name, such as veg biryani or curd rice.
validation_rules.error_message: Tell us what food you have, for example 40 plates veg biryani.

validation_rules.description: Quantity is a whole or decimal number greater than 0 and no more than 5000 in the selected unit.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter a quantity between 1 and 5000.

validation_rules.description: Quantity unit must be chosen as kg or servings.
validation_rules.error_message: Choose kg or servings for the quantity.

validation_rules.description: Pickup-by is a date and time that is required for the listing to be posted.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter the time the food must be picked up by.

validation_rules.description: Pickup-by must be at least 30 minutes after the current time.
validation_rules.error_message: Pickup-by must be at least 30 minutes from now, so receivers have time to collect.

validation_rules.description: The free-text post is at most 500 characters.
validation_rules.error_message: Keep your post under 500 characters. Shorten the description and try again.

steps.description: Intake service calls the LLM to extract items, quantities and pickup-by time; allergens are left as 'unknown — ask donor' rather than invented.

business_rules.name: intake_must_not_invent_quantities_or_allergens
business_rules.description: The LLM extracts items, quantities and pickup-by time only from the donor's words, and never fills in a quantity or allergen that the donor did not state.
triggers: Donor submits a free-text or voice post on the posting screen
IntakeApiRoute sends the donor's text to the LLM for extraction
side_effects: Listing.items, Listing.total_quantity, Listing.quantity_unit and Listing.pickup_by_at are set only to values found in Listing.raw_input
Any field the extraction cannot source from the input is left empty and returned to the donor as unanswered
error_handling: LLM returns a quantity or time not present in the input: the value is dropped, the field is left empty and the donor is asked for it
LLM returns an allergen not present in the input or the documented food-to-allergen map: the allergen is discarded and logged
Extraction output fails the JSON schema: one retry, then the plain 3-field form is shown

business_rules.name: allergens_default_to_unknown_pending_donor_answer
business_rules.description: Listing.allergens is set to 'unknown — ask donor' for every item unless the donor states the allergen or the item matches a documented food-to-allergen map entry, and it is never assumed absent.
triggers: Extraction completes for a post
Donor edits an item name or type in the confirmation screen
side_effects: Listing.allergens shows 'unknown — ask donor' for each item without a stated or mapped allergen
The confirmation screen highlights the allergen field for the donor to answer
The receiver sees 'unknown — ask donor' on the handling card
error_handling: Donor leaves allergens blank on confirmation: the value stays 'unknown — ask donor' and the listing is not treated as allergen-free
Map lookup finds an implicit allergen (for example paneer implies milk): the mapped allergen is added and marked as inferred for the donor to confirm

business_rules.name: donor_confirmation_required_before_listing_is_posted
business_rules.description: Extracted fields stay unconfirmed and the listing is not posted until the donor reviews the extracted values against the original text and confirms them.
triggers: Extraction returns fields to the donor
Donor taps confirm on the confirmation screen
side_effects: Listing.status stays unposted until the donor confirms; on confirmation it moves to posted
Each extracted field is flagged 'AI-filled' until the donor confirms it
error_handling: Donor closes the screen without confirming: no listing is posted and the draft is discarded after the session ends
Donor edits a field after extraction: the field is no longer AI-filled and the edited value is stored

business_rules.name: single_follow_up_for_missing_pickup_by_time
business_rules.description: When the donor's text has no pickup-by time, the system asks exactly one follow-up question for it and fills nothing in.
triggers: Extraction finds no pickup-by time in the donor's text
side_effects: Donor is asked one question for the pickup-by time
Listing.pickup_by_at stays empty until the donor answers
error_handling: Donor does not answer the follow-up: the form is shown with pickup-by time as a required field and the listing cannot be confirmed
Donor's answer is unparseable: the form field is shown for direct entry

business_rules.name: ai_failure_falls_back_to_plain_form
business_rules.description: If the LLM call takes longer than 5 seconds or returns invalid output after one retry, the donor is shown the plain 3-field form and posting continues without AI.
triggers: Anthropic call exceeds 5 seconds
Anthropic response fails the JSON schema on the first attempt and again on the retry
side_effects: Donor sees the 3-field form pre-filled with any text the donor already typed
Listing.allergens is set to 'unknown — ask donor' for every item entered on the form
Listing.raw_input is kept so the original text is visible to the donor
error_handling: Anthropic is unavailable: form shown immediately, no extraction attempted
Retry also fails: form shown and the failure is logged with the request and response

business_rules.name: discard_output_with_banned_claim_or_injected_instruction
business_rules.description: Extraction output containing a banned claim (such as 'safe', 'certified' or a tax benefit) or an obeyed injected instruction is discarded and the form is used instead.
triggers: Anthropic response contains banned wording
Donor's text contains an instruction that changes the extracted values
side_effects: Extraction result is not shown to the donor
The case is logged for admin review and added to the golden set
Donor is shown the plain form with the quantities and items they typed
error_handling: Banned word appears in extracted item names: output discarded and the form is used
Injected instruction is detected in the input: only the food details are extracted and the case is logged

business_rules.name: extracted_zone_must_be_launch_zone
business_rules.description: The pickup zone found in the donor's text must match one of the 8 launch zones, otherwise posting is blocked with a clear message.
triggers: Extraction returns a location for the pickup
Donor selects a zone on the confirmation screen
side_effects: Listing.zone is set to the matched launch zone (Patia, Chandrasekharpur, Saheed Nagar, Nayapalli, Jaydev Vihar, Khandagiri, Old Town or Rasulgarh)
Donor is told the zone is outside the launch area if no match is found
error_handling: Location is not a launch zone: posting is blocked and the donor is asked to choose a zone
Location is ambiguous between two zones: donor is asked to choose one

business_rules.name: log_every_extraction_call
business_rules.description: Every extraction call is logged with the prompt version, model, input text, raw output, validated fields and token count.
triggers: Each call from IntakeApiRoute to the LLM, whether it succeeds or fails
side_effects: An audit entry is recorded against the Listing for the extraction
Token usage is counted towards the monthly budget and the 70% alert
error_handling: Logging fails: the extraction result is still returned and the failure is raised as an internal alert

validation_rules.description: The donor's post text or voice transcript is required before extraction runs.
validation_rules.error_message: Please describe the food you are donating, for example: 40 plates veg biryani, pickup by 11:30.

validation_rules.description: The donor's post text is between 1 and 1000 characters.
validation_rules.error_message: Your post is too long. Please keep it under 1000 characters.

validation_rules.description: Extracted or entered quantity is greater than 0 and at most 5000 in the chosen unit.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter a quantity between 1 and 5000 (kg or servings).

validation_rules.description: Quantity unit must be kg or servings for every extracted or entered quantity.
validation_rules.error_message: Choose whether the quantity is in kg or servings.

validation_rules.description: A pickup-by date and time must be confirmed by the donor before the listing can be posted.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter the pickup-by time so receivers know when the food must be collected.

validation_rules.description: Each item must have an allergen answer: a stated allergen list or 'unknown — ask donor'; blank is not accepted.
validation_rules.error_message: Answer the allergen question for each item, or keep it as unknown.

steps.description: Donor checks each AI-filled field against the original text, corrects any errors and confirms the listing.

business_rules.name: donor_confirmation_required_before_posting
business_rules.description: A Listing moves from AI draft to Posted only after the donor has reviewed and confirmed every AI-filled field, so AI output never acts without a person's decision.
triggers: Donor taps 'Confirm and post' on the confirmation screen
Donor leaves the confirmation screen without confirming
side_effects: Listing.status becomes Posted (from draft) only after confirmation
a StatusEvent is logged with the donor as actor, the time, and the confirmed field values
Listing is not offered to any receiver until it is Posted
error_handling: Donor exits without confirming: Listing stays in draft, nothing is offered, and the donor can return to finish
Confirmation attempted with a required field empty: confirmation is blocked and the empty field is highlighted

business_rules.name: ai_filled_fields_flagged_until_donor_confirms
business_rules.description: Each AI-filled field is marked 'AI-filled' and shown beside the original text until the donor confirms or corrects it, and the marker clears only on confirmation.
triggers: Confirmation screen loads with AI-extracted values
Donor edits an AI-filled field
side_effects: unconfirmed fields keep the 'AI-filled' marker in the donor view
a corrected field is stored with the donor's value and the original AI value is kept in the audit log
error_handling: Field missing from the original text: shown as empty with the AI-filled marker removed, not guessed
Donor leaves a flagged field unchanged: the value is treated as confirmed only when the donor confirms the whole listing

business_rules.name: allergens_default_to_unknown_never_assumed_absent
business_rules.description: Listing.allergens is set to 'unknown — ask donor' unless the donor explicitly enters allergens, and an unknown allergen is never treated as absent.
triggers: AI returns no allergen or only an implicit allergen hint
Donor clears the allergen field
Donor confirms the listing
side_effects: Listing.allergens shows 'unknown — ask donor' on the receiver-facing handling card when not set
implicit allergens suggested by the AI (for example milk in paneer or kheer) are shown to the donor for confirmation
error_handling: Donor confirms with allergens blank: value is stored as 'unknown — ask donor', not empty
AI suggests an allergen the donor deletes: the deletion is logged with the donor as actor

business_rules.name: consume_by_recalculated_on_correction_and_capped_by_rule_table
business_rules.description: When the donor corrects pickup-by time, quantity or items, Listing.consume_by is recalculated as the earliest of the donor's pickup-by and the rule-table limit, and can never be extended beyond the rule table.
triggers: Donor changes Listing.pickup_by
Donor changes Listing.items or Listing.storage in a way that changes the food type
Confirmation screen loads
side_effects: Listing.consume_by updates and is displayed on the confirmation screen and handling card
the rule-table version used is recorded on the Listing
error_handling: Corrected pickup-by would push consume-by past the rule-table limit: the rule-table limit is used and the donor is told why
No rule-table entry for the food type: the most conservative limit applies and it is labelled as such

business_rules.name: listing_too_close_to_deadline_marked_unrescuable
business_rules.description: If the confirmed pickup-by time leaves less than 30 minutes before the consume-by deadline, the Listing is marked unrescuable and is not offered to any receiver.
triggers: Donor confirms a listing with pickup-by under 30 minutes away
Donor corrects pickup-by to a time under 30 minutes away
side_effects: Listing.status becomes Expired or stays unrescuable and is not moved to Posted
the donor is shown the reason on the confirmation screen
a StatusEvent records the unrescuable decision
error_handling: Donor tries to confirm: confirmation is blocked and the donor is told the pickup-by time is too close to the deadline
Pickup-by already passed: listing cannot be confirmed and the donor is asked to set a new time

business_rules.name: unlicensed_or_expired_donor_blocked_from_confirming
business_rules.description: A donor whose FSSAI licence or registration number is unverified, expired or mismatched cannot confirm and post a Listing.
triggers: Donor taps 'Confirm and post'
Confirmation screen loads for a donor with a changed or expired licence
side_effects: Listing stays in draft and nothing is offered
the donor sees a clear reason, and a StatusEvent records the blocked attempt
error_handling: Licence number unverified (demo: mocked check): posting is blocked with the reason 'FSSAI licence not verified'
Licence expired: posting is blocked and the donor is told to renew
Name or address on licence does not match the account: posting is blocked pending review

business_rules.name: donor_zone_must_be_launch_zone
business_rules.description: A donor whose zone is outside the eight launch zones cannot confirm a Listing.
triggers: Donor taps 'Confirm and post' for a donor whose zone is not a launch zone
side_effects: Listing stays in draft
the donor is told the service is not yet available in their zone
error_handling: Zone outside the eight launch zones: posting blocked with a clear message

business_rules.name: duplicate_listing_requires_donor_reconfirmation
business_rules.description: If the same donor posts the same items within 10 minutes of an existing Listing, the donor must confirm that a second listing is intended before it is created.
triggers: Donor confirms a listing whose items match another Listing by the same donor within 10 minutes
side_effects: Listing stays in draft until the donor explicitly confirms it is a separate event
a StatusEvent records the duplicate warning and the donor's choice
error_handling: Donor cancels the second post: the draft is discarded and the original Listing is unchanged

business_rules.name: handling_card_complete_and_disclaimer_fixed_before_posting
business_rules.description: A Listing cannot move to Posted unless its handling card has a consume-by time, storage guidance, allergen tags and the fixed disclaimer 'Not certified safe — follow handling guidance'.
triggers: Donor taps 'Confirm and post'
Donor edits storage or allergens on the confirmation screen
side_effects: handling card is attached to the Listing and shown on every screen
the disclaimer text is stored as the fixed value and cannot be edited by the donor
error_handling: Any of the four elements missing: confirmation blocked and the missing element named
Donor edits the disclaimer text: edit rejected and the fixed text restored

business_rules.name: generated_listing_text_scanned_for_banned_claims
business_rules.description: Any free-text field the donor edits on the confirmation screen is scanned for banned food-safety and tax or legal claims before the Listing is confirmed.
triggers: Donor edits Listing.items or any notes field
Donor taps 'Confirm and post'
side_effects: banned wording is removed or blocked and the donor is told which phrase was not allowed
a StatusEvent records the blocked wording
error_handling: Text contains 'safe', 'certified' or a tax claim such as '80G': confirmation blocked until the wording is removed
Injection attempt detected in input: the instruction is ignored and logged for admin review

business_rules.name: confirmed_listing_and_corrections_logged
business_rules.description: Every correction the donor makes to an AI-filled field and the final confirmation are logged with time, actor, original AI value and confirmed value.
triggers: Donor changes any AI-filled field
Donor confirms the listing
side_effects: StatusEvent records the confirmation with the before and after values
corrected extraction pairs are queued for the golden dataset review
error_handling: Logging fails: confirmation is not completed and the donor is asked to retry

validation_rules.description: Each listing must have at least one item with a name.
validation_rules.error_message: Add at least one food item before confirming.

validation_rules.description: Total quantity is greater than 0 kg or servings, with a unit of kg or servings.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter a quantity greater than zero, in kg or servings.

validation_rules.description: Pickup-by time is in the future and at least 30 minutes from now.
validation_rules.error_message: Pickup-by must be at least 30 minutes from now.

validation_rules.description: Allergens must be tagged from the allergen list or set to 'unknown — ask donor'; blank is not accepted.
validation_rules.error_message: Choose the allergens or select 'unknown — ask donor'.

validation_rules.description: Storage type is selected from the allowed storage options.
validation_rules.error_message: Select how the food is stored.

validation_rules.description: Donor must tick that they have checked every AI-filled field against the original text before posting.
validation_rules.error_message: Tick to confirm you have checked the fields against your original text.

steps.description: Listing detail shows the handling card (consume-by time, storage, allergens, fixed disclaimer) and status Posted.

business_rules.name: listing_cannot_reach_posted_without_complete_handling_card
business_rules.description: A listing moves to Posted only when its handling card has all four parts: consume-by time, storage guidance, allergen tags, and the fixed disclaimer (draft → Posted).
triggers: Donor confirms a listing after AI or form extraction
Listing detail page loads for a listing in Posted status
side_effects: Listing.status becomes Posted only when all four handling card fields are present
StatusEvent is recorded for the move to Posted with the donor as actor
error_handling: If any handling card field is missing, the listing stays in draft and the donor sees which part is missing
If storage or allergen data is absent, the listing does not reach Posted and nothing is offered

business_rules.name: consume_by_is_earliest_of_pickup_by_and_rule_table_limit
business_rules.description: The consume-by deadline equals the earlier of the donor's pickup-by time and the rule-table limit for the food type, prep time and storage, and is shown on the listing detail page.
triggers: Listing is created or edited with pickup-by time, food type and storage
Listing detail page loads
side_effects: Listing.consume_by is set from the rule table version in force at posting
The consume-by time is displayed on the handling card
error_handling: If the rule table has no entry for the food type or storage, the most conservative limit is used and labelled as such
If the computed deadline is already passed or under 30 minutes away, the listing is marked unrescuable and the donor is told why

business_rules.name: fixed_food_safety_disclaimer_on_every_listing
business_rules.description: Every listing shows the fixed disclaimer "Not certified safe — follow handling guidance" exactly as written, and no generated text may describe the food as safe or certified.
triggers: Listing detail page loads
Listing is posted
side_effects: The disclaimer text is attached to the listing and displayed on the handling card
Guardrail scanner checks listing copy for banned words such as safe or certified
error_handling: If the disclaimer is missing or altered, the listing cannot be marked Posted
If any listing text contains a banned claim, the text is discarded and the fixed template is used

business_rules.name: unknown_allergens_shown_not_assumed_absent
business_rules.description: Allergens that were not stated or extracted are shown as "unknown — ask donor" and are never displayed as absent.
triggers: Listing detail page loads with no confirmed allergen data
AI intake leaves allergens empty
side_effects: Receivers see "unknown — ask donor" on the handling card for unconfirmed allergens
error_handling: If allergen data is blank, the handling card shows unknown rather than none
If the AI cannot determine allergens, the field defaults to unknown

business_rules.name: posted_status_recorded_as_status_event
business_rules.description: The move of a listing into Posted is recorded as a timestamped StatusEvent that names the actor, so the detail page shows Posted with its time and actor.
triggers: Donor confirms and posts a listing
side_effects: A StatusEvent with from_status draft and to_status Posted is written with the donor as actor and the current time
The listing detail page displays the Posted status and its timestamp
error_handling: If the StatusEvent write fails, the Posted status is not shown as final and the post is retried or rolled back

name: Matching and Offer Cascade
description: Once a listing is posted, deterministic matching filters and ranks receivers, sends the top offer with its reason, and cascades to the next receiver if there is no reply within 5 minutes.

steps.description: On confirmation, matching applies hard filters (time, capacity, allergens, radius, FSSAI registration) and ranks eligible receivers by score.

business_rules.name: hard_filters_exclude_ineligible_receivers
business_rules.description: A receiver is excluded from matching if it fails any hard filter: it cannot deliver before the consume-by deadline minus a 15-minute buffer, it cannot accept at least 50% of the listing quantity today, it has an allergen or dietary conflict with the listing, or it is inactive or beyond the 8 km maximum radius.
triggers: Donor confirms a listing and it moves from Listing draft to Posted
Donor edits a listing and the quantity change exceeds 20%, which re-runs matching
side_effects: Only receivers passing all four filters become candidates for ranking
Excluded receivers never see an Offer for this Listing
Each excluded receiver's failed filter is recorded in the matching log
error_handling: No candidate passes the filters: widen the radius once from 8 km to 12 km and re-run the filters
Still no candidate after widening: the donor is told no match was found and Listing.status moves to Closed
Receiver has an allergen conflict with an item that is unknown: the item is treated as a conflict, not as absent

business_rules.name: listings_too_close_to_deadline_are_unrescuable
business_rules.description: A listing whose consume-by deadline is less than 30 minutes away at posting is never offered and is marked unrescuable (Listing.status = Unrescuable with a reason).
triggers: Donor confirms a listing with a pickup-by time that is already past or under 30 minutes away
side_effects: Listing.status becomes Unrescuable
The donor is told why the listing cannot be rescued
No Offer records are created for the listing
error_handling: Deadline already passed at confirmation: listing is rejected with the reason shown to the donor
Deadline falls under 30 minutes during matching: matching stops and the listing is marked Unrescuable

business_rules.name: ranked_candidates_scored_by_weighted_formula
business_rules.description: Eligible receivers are ranked by score = 0.35 × time_slack + 0.25 × (1 − distance/radius) + 0.20 × need + 0.15 × quantity_fit + 0.05 × reliability, with each term scaled from 0 to 1 and ties going to the receiver with higher need.
triggers: Hard filters leave one or more eligible receivers for a confirmed listing
Configured scoring weights are changed by an admin
side_effects: Each eligible receiver gets an Offer.score and Offer.rank for this Listing
The top-ranked receiver becomes the first candidate for an Offer
error_handling: A score term cannot be computed (missing distance or need value): that receiver is excluded from ranking and the omission is logged
Reliability term is capped at 5% of total weight so it cannot dominate the ranking

business_rules.name: every_match_carries_plain_language_reason
business_rules.description: Each ranked candidate is stored with a plain-language reason that states distance, quantity it can serve and time margin before the deadline.
triggers: A candidate receiver is scored and ranked for a listing
side_effects: Offer.reason is stored and shown to the receiver with the offer
The reason text is written to the matching log for audit
error_handling: Reason cannot be built from available values: the offer is held back and the matching step is retried once

business_rules.name: only_fssai_registered_receivers_are_matched
business_rules.description: A receiver whose FSSAI registration is not verified is never included in matching, so only FSSAI-registered surplus food distribution organisations can receive food.
triggers: Matching starts for a confirmed listing
A receiver's registration status changes
side_effects: Unregistered or expired receivers are dropped from the candidate list
Excluded receivers are logged with the reason 'FSSAI registration not verified'
error_handling: Registration status cannot be read (mocked check unavailable): the receiver is excluded, not included by default
Registration expired since last check: the receiver is excluded and the admin is alerted

business_rules.name: over_capacity_listing_split_across_receivers
business_rules.description: When the listing quantity is larger than any one receiver can take, the quantity is split across up to three receivers, each with its own offer quantity.
triggers: No single eligible receiver can accept the full listing quantity
Top-ranked receivers together can cover the listing quantity
side_effects: Up to three Offer records are created for the listing, each with its own quantity
Each split offer will receive its own handover code at claim
error_handling: Combined capacity of the top three receivers is still short: the donor is told the shortfall and offers go to the available receivers
Split would require more than three receivers: the split is capped at three and the remainder is reported to the donor

business_rules.name: matching_is_deterministic_and_never_llm
business_rules.description: Hard filters, scoring and ranking run as plain deterministic code, so the same inputs always produce the same ranked list and reasons.
triggers: Matching runs for any listing
A regression test runs the matching golden set
side_effects: Matching results can be reproduced and tested with the matching golden set (G-MAT)
No AI service is called during matching
error_handling: Matching code throws an error: no offer is sent, the listing stays Posted and the error is logged for the admin

business_rules.name: top_offer_gets_five_minute_timeout
business_rules.description: The top-ranked receiver is sent an Offer with a sent time and an expires time five minutes later, which can be configured.
triggers: Ranking produces a top candidate for a listing
The previous offer for the listing expires without a response
side_effects: Listing.status becomes Offered
The top receiver sees the offer with its reason and deadline
Expiry is scheduled on the server so it runs even if the app is closed
error_handling: Offer cannot be created because the receiver is no longer eligible: the next ranked candidate is used
Server restarts while the offer is open: expiry is rebuilt from the database on start-up

steps.description: Top-ranked receiver sees the new offer with a plain-language reason in their offers list.

business_rules.name: offer_shows_plain_language_reason
business_rules.description: Each offer shown to a receiver carries the plain-language reason it was chosen (for example, distance, quantity it can serve and time slack) so the receiver can judge it before accepting.
triggers: The matching step ranks receivers and creates an Offer for the top-ranked receiver
The receiver opens the offers list and views a pending offer
side_effects: The receiver sees the Offer in their offers list with its reason text
The reason text is drawn from the score terms computed by matching code, not generated by an AI model
error_handling: If the reason cannot be produced for a candidate, that offer is not sent and the next ranked receiver is considered
If the reason text contains a banned claim or unsafe wording (for example 'safe' or 'certified'), the reason is replaced with the plain template and the case is logged for the admin

business_rules.name: offer_goes_only_to_current_top_match
business_rules.description: An offer is visible only to the single receiver currently at the top of the ranked list for that listing, and other receivers do not see it until the cascade reaches them.
triggers: Matching produces a ranked list of receivers for a listing
The previous top-ranked receiver's offer expires or is declined
side_effects: Only the top-ranked receiver's offers list shows the new Offer
Offer.sent_at is set to the moment the offer is delivered to that receiver
error_handling: If the receiver is no longer active when the offer is created, the offer is not shown to them and the cascade moves to the next ranked receiver
If no ranked receiver remains, the listing moves to the matching fallback (widen radius once, then tell the donor no match was found)

business_rules.name: offer_expires_after_timeout_and_cascades
business_rules.description: An offer stays open for a configurable timeout (5 minutes by default) and, if the receiver does not respond, its response is recorded as expired and the offer passes to the next ranked receiver.
triggers: An Offer is created and sent to a receiver
The offer timeout elapses with no response from the receiver
Server restart while offers are open
side_effects: Offer.expires_at is set to sent_at plus the configured timeout
When the timeout passes, Offer.response becomes expired and the next receiver receives a new Offer
The receiver sees the offer disappear from their offers list once it expires
error_handling: If the timeout is reached while the receiver is accepting, the first confirmed write wins and the late response is rejected with 'already claimed' or 'offer expired'
After a server restart, expiry timers are rebuilt from the stored Offer.expires_at values

business_rules.name: offer_not_sent_past_listing_deadline
business_rules.description: An offer is never created or shown when the listing's consume-by deadline is too close to allow a pickup and delivery inside the time window, so food is never offered past its deadline.
triggers: Matching is about to create an Offer for a listing
An offer's timeout expires and the cascade is about to move to the next receiver
side_effects: If the deadline cannot be met, no Offer is created and the listing is expired
The donor and all parties are told the listing has expired
error_handling: If the offer's expiry would fall after the consume-by deadline, the offer is shortened to end at the deadline or is not sent
If the listing is already past its consume-by deadline, the listing is expired and the offer is withdrawn from the receiver's list

business_rules.name: offer_requires_fssai_registered_receiver
business_rules.description: Only a receiver with a valid FSSAI registration can receive an offer, so an unregistered receiver never sees a listing in their offers list.
triggers: Matching evaluates a candidate receiver as a hard filter
A receiver's registration status changes
side_effects: Receivers without a valid registration are excluded before any Offer is created for them
An Offer already pending for a receiver whose registration lapses is withdrawn from their offers list
error_handling: If the registration check cannot be completed, the receiver is excluded from matching for that listing and the reason is logged
A receiver with an unverified or mismatched registration number never appears in the offers list

steps.description: No reply within 5 minutes; the offer timer expires, the offer is logged and moved to the next matched receiver.

business_rules.name: offer_timeout_cascades_to_next_match
business_rules.description: An offer with no reply within 5 minutes (configurable) moves from sent → expired, and the listing is offered to the next ranked receiver (sent → expired, then the next offer is sent).
triggers: The offer timer reaches expires_at with Offer.response still empty
The receiver does not respond to the offer within the 5-minute window
side_effects: Offer.status becomes expired and Offer.response is recorded as no reply
a StatusEvent is logged with the time and actor system for the expiry
the next ranked receiver receives a new Offer with its own sent_at, expires_at, score and reason
a StatusEvent is logged for the new offer
Listing.status stays offered while the cascade continues
error_handling: If the next ranked receiver fails a hard filter by now, skip it and move to the following match
If no remaining match exists, follow the no-match fallback: widen the radius once, then tell the donor no match was found
If the offer timer fails to fire, the expiry is still applied on server start-up from the stored expires_at
If the expired receiver replies after expiry, the reply is rejected and the offer stays expired

business_rules.name: no_offer_sent_past_consume_by_deadline
business_rules.description: A new offer is created only if the pickup ETA plus delivery time is earlier than the listing's consume-by deadline minus a 15-minute buffer; otherwise the listing expires (Offered → Expired).
triggers: An offer expires and the cascade looks for the next receiver
Time passes so that the remaining window before consume-by is under the 15-minute buffer
side_effects: no new Offer is created for the listing
Listing.status becomes expired
a StatusEvent is logged with the actor system
the donor and the matched receivers are notified of the expiry
error_handling: If the consume-by deadline is already past when the timer fires, expire the listing immediately and do not send any offer
If the deadline check cannot be computed, use the most conservative rule and expire the listing rather than offer past the deadline

business_rules.name: every_offer_transition_is_logged
business_rules.description: Each offer status change from sent to expired, and each new offer sent, writes a StatusEvent with the time and actor.
triggers: An offer expires
A new offer is sent during the cascade
side_effects: a StatusEvent is recorded for each offer transition with from state, to state, actor and timestamp
the event log can rebuild the full offer history for a listing
error_handling: If the StatusEvent write fails, the offer transition is rolled back so the log and the offer status never disagree
Duplicate expiry events for the same offer are ignored

business_rules.name: cascade_respects_hard_filters_and_ranking
business_rules.description: The next offer goes to the highest-scoring receiver who still passes all hard filters (ETA, capacity, allergen/dietary conflict, active and within radius, FSSAI-registered), with ties going to the higher need.
triggers: An offer expires and the cascade chooses the next match
side_effects: the new Offer records the chosen receiver, its score and a plain-language reason
receivers who failed a hard filter are not offered the listing
error_handling: If a candidate becomes unavailable between ranking and sending, skip to the next candidate in rank order
If the ranked list is empty, follow the no-match fallback

business_rules.name: claim_only_while_offer_is_open
business_rules.description: A receiver can claim a listing only while its offer is open (sent → claimed); after expiry the offer can no longer be accepted.
triggers: A receiver submits an acceptance after the offer timer has expired
Two receivers accept at the same moment
side_effects: a late acceptance is rejected and the offer remains expired
the first confirmed claim sets the listing to claimed and the other offers to expired
error_handling: A late response returns a clear message that the offer has expired
The atomic update ensures only one claim wins when two receivers accept together

business_rules.name: cascade_state_survives_restart
business_rules.description: Open offers and their expiry times are stored in the database so the 5-minute timeouts are rebuilt and enforced after a server restart.
triggers: The server restarts while offers are open
The app starts up
side_effects: timers for all open offers are rebuilt from stored expires_at values
offers past their expires_at are expired and the cascade continues
error_handling: If an expires_at is missing, treat the offer as expired immediately and log the anomaly
Overdue offers are processed in order of expires_at to keep the cascade fair

steps.description: Next receiver sees the same listing as a fresh offer with its reason.

business_rules.name: next_receiver_gets_fresh_offer_on_timeout
business_rules.description: When a receiver does not reply within 5 minutes, the same listing becomes a new Offer to the next-ranked receiver, with its own sent time, expiry and reason.
triggers: Offer.expires_at passes with Offer.response still pending
Receiver declines an offer
side_effects: The previous Offer.response is set to timed_out or declined
A new Offer is created for the next-ranked receiver for the same Listing
Listing.status stays Offered
A StatusEvent is logged with the time and the actor (system or receiver)
The next receiver sees the listing as a fresh offer with its own reason
error_handling: If the next receiver is no longer active or fails a hard filter at re-offer time, skip to the following candidate
If no candidates remain, widen the radius once from 8 km to 12 km and re-rank
If still no candidate, close the offer cycle and tell the donor no match was found

business_rules.name: offer_shows_receiver_specific_reason
business_rules.description: Each Offer carries a plain-language reason generated from that receiver's own distance, serving fit and time slack, such as '3.2 km away, can serve 40, arrives 45 min before deadline'.
triggers: A new Offer is created for a receiver
A receiver opens an offer
side_effects: The receiver sees the listing with the reason for their own match
The reason is stored on the Offer for later audit
error_handling: If the reason cannot be computed, the offer is not shown and the cascade moves to the next candidate
The reason must not claim food is safe or certified

business_rules.name: re_offer_must_meet_deadline_and_hard_filters
business_rules.description: A listing is re-offered only if the candidate's pickup plus delivery arrives earlier than the consume-by deadline minus a 15-minute buffer, and the candidate passes all hard filters.
triggers: Before each re-offer in the cascade
Before any widened-radius re-offer
side_effects: Ineligible candidates get no Offer record
If the offer window would run past consume_by minus 15 minutes, the offer is not sent and Listing.status moves toward Expired
error_handling: If no candidate can meet the deadline, Listing.status becomes Expired and the donor, receivers and volunteers are told
Listings already within 30 minutes of consume_by are not re-offered

business_rules.name: offer_stops_when_listing_already_claimed
business_rules.description: When a listing is claimed by another receiver first, any open or newly opened Offer for it shows 'already claimed' and cannot be accepted.
triggers: Another receiver's claim succeeds on the same Listing
A receiver opens or accepts an Offer for a listing already claimed
side_effects: The losing receiver's Offer.response is set to a closed state and they see 'already claimed'
No second claim is written for the listing
error_handling: If two accepts arrive at the same moment, the first confirmed atomic write wins and the other receiver is told 'already claimed'

business_rules.name: receiver_not_reoffered_same_listing
business_rules.description: A receiver who has already declined or timed out on a listing does not receive a new Offer for that same listing.
triggers: Candidate ranking runs during cascade
A receiver declines or times out
side_effects: Previously tried receivers are removed from the candidate list for that listing
error_handling: If the only remaining candidates were all tried, the cascade ends and the donor is told no match was found

business_rules.name: offer_status_visible_and_logged_on_each_change
business_rules.description: Each new Offer and each change in Offer.response is written as a timestamped StatusEvent with the actor, so the listing status is visible to all parties within 5 seconds.
triggers: A new Offer is created
An Offer.response changes
side_effects: A StatusEvent is recorded for each cascade step
Donor and receivers see the updated listing status
error_handling: If the StatusEvent write fails, the cascade step is not completed and is retried

name: Receiver Accepts Offer and Confirms Servings
description: A receiver reviews a ranked offer, reads its handling card, accepts it, sees the volunteer ETA and later confirms the servings actually received.

steps.description: Receiver signs in and selects the receiver role.

business_rules.name: receiver_role_requires_fssai_registration
business_rules.description: A user may select the receiver role only if their linked receiver organisation holds a verified FSSAI registration, because only FSSAI-registered surplus food distribution organisations can receive food.
triggers: User selects the receiver role on the login page
User submits sign-in with the receiver role chosen
side_effects: User.role is set to receiver only when User.fssai_verified is true
the receiver home view with offers and the live status board is shown to the user
an unverified user is kept on the login page with the reason shown and no receiver session is started
error_handling: User.fssai_verified is false or User.fssai_number is missing: role is not set and the user is told the receiver organisation is not FSSAI-registered
FSSAI check is mocked in the demo; mocked results use synthetic licence numbers and are labelled as mocked
User has no linked receiver organisation: receiver role is not offered

business_rules.name: demo_role_switcher_selects_existing_user_role
business_rules.description: In the MVP, the account step is a role switcher for the demo, so the user picks an existing synthetic user and the receiver role without a real password check, with real sign-in deferred to hardening.
triggers: User opens the login page in the demo
User chooses a synthetic receiver user from the role switcher
side_effects: the chosen synthetic User becomes the active session user with role receiver
all receiver views (offers, claims, deliveries) show data linked to that User
error_handling: No synthetic receiver user exists in the seed data: the role switcher shows an empty state and the seed-reset script is suggested
User switches role while another role is active: the previous session role is replaced

business_rules.name: receiver_identity_uses_synthetic_data_only
business_rules.description: Only synthetic user and organisation details are accepted and stored at sign-in, so no real personal details or addresses are held in the MVP.
triggers: User signs in or selects a role from the demo role switcher
side_effects: User.email is stored in masked form for display
User.name shows generated synthetic names
error_handling: A real-looking address or personal detail is typed into the sign-in field: the field is rejected with a message that only synthetic data is allowed

validation_rules.description: A role must be selected from the role switcher before the user can continue.
validation_rules.error_message: Choose a role to continue.

validation_rules.description: The sign-in identifier must be a well-formed email address that matches a synthetic user in the seed data.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter a valid email address.

steps.description: Receiver reviews ranked offers and the reason each was chosen.

business_rules.name: offers_ranked_by_deterministic_score
business_rules.description: Offers shown to a receiver are ordered by a deterministic score of time slack (0.35), distance within radius (0.25), need (0.20), quantity fit (0.15) and reliability (0.05, capped), with ties going to the receiver with the higher need.
triggers: Receiver opens the offers page
Matching run produces or updates offers for a listing
side_effects: Offer.score is stored for each offer so the order can be reproduced and tested
The receiver sees offers in rank order, best first
error_handling: If a receiver's reliability is missing, the reliability term is treated as zero and the offer is still ranked
If scoring fails for a candidate, that candidate is left out of the list and the failure is logged

business_rules.name: each_offer_shows_plain_language_reason
business_rules.description: Every offer carries a plain-language reason that states distance, how much the receiver can serve and how far ahead of the deadline it arrives, such as '3.2 km away, can serve 40, arrives 45 min before deadline'.
triggers: Matching run creates an offer
Receiver opens an offer on the offers page
side_effects: Offer.reason is stored with the offer so the receiver sees the same explanation the system used
The receiver can see why each listing was chosen for them
error_handling: If a reason cannot be built from the stored values, the offer is not shown and the failure is logged

business_rules.name: only_hard_filter_passing_receivers_receive_offers
business_rules.description: A receiver receives an offer only if the pickup ETA plus delivery time is earlier than the consume-by deadline minus 15 minutes, they can accept at least 50% of the listing quantity today, there is no allergen or dietary conflict, they are FSSAI-registered, active and within 8 km (widened to 12 km once if no match).
triggers: Matching run evaluates candidate receivers for a listing
Radius widening after no match is found
side_effects: Only receivers passing all four filters get an Offer record
If no receiver passes after widening, the donor is told no match was found and the listing is closed
error_handling: A receiver failing any filter is excluded and does not see the listing
Unregistered receivers never appear in matching

business_rules.name: offer_expires_after_five_minutes_and_cascades
business_rules.description: An offer with no response within 5 minutes (configurable) moves from pending to expired and the next-ranked receiver receives the offer.
triggers: Offer.expires_at passes with no response
Receiver declines an offer
side_effects: Offer.response is set to expired or declined
The next-ranked receiver receives a new offer with its own expiry
A StatusEvent is logged with the actor and time
error_handling: If no next receiver exists, the listing expires and all parties are notified
Expiry runs server-side so it still happens if the receiver closes the app

business_rules.name: offers_closed_at_listing_consume_by_deadline
business_rules.description: An offer's expiry is capped at the listing's consume-by deadline, and no offer can be viewed as open or accepted once that deadline has passed.
triggers: Offer is created or sent
Listing.consume_by time is reached
side_effects: Offer.expires_at is set to the earlier of its own timeout and Listing.consume_by
Open offers past the deadline are marked expired and the listing moves to Expired if unclaimed
The receiver sees that the offer has expired
error_handling: A receiver who tries to respond after the deadline sees that the offer has expired and cannot accept it
Offers past the deadline are never re-sent

business_rules.name: offer_shows_handling_card_and_unknown_allergens
business_rules.description: Each offer shows the listing's consume-by time, storage guidance, allergen tags and the fixed disclaimer 'Not certified safe — follow handling guidance', with any unknown allergen shown as 'unknown — ask donor'.
triggers: Receiver opens an offer
side_effects: The receiver sees the handling card before deciding to accept
error_handling: If the handling card is incomplete, the offer is not shown and the listing is flagged for review
An unknown allergen is never displayed as absent

business_rules.name: exact_pickup_point_hidden_until_volunteer_assigned
business_rules.description: The offer shows only the donor's zone and jittered distance; the exact pickup point is revealed only to the assigned volunteer.
triggers: Receiver opens an offer
side_effects: Receiver sees zone-level location and approximate distance only
error_handling: If a receiver requests the exact point before a claim, the request is denied and not logged as a location view

steps.description: Receiver reads the handling card and allergens, accepts the offer, and a volunteer is assigned with an ETA.

business_rules.name: only_fssai_registered_receiver_can_accept_offer
business_rules.description: A receiver can accept an offer only if its FSSAI registration is verified, since unregistered receivers must never be matched or claim food.
triggers: Receiver presses Accept on the offer detail page
side_effects: If the receiver is verified, Offer.status becomes accepted and the claim proceeds
If not verified, the accept is refused and no StatusEvent is written for a claim
error_handling: Receiver not FSSAI-registered: accept is blocked with a clear reason shown on the page
Receiver registration lapsed since the offer was sent: accept is blocked and the offer moves to the next match

business_rules.name: offer_must_be_open_and_unexpired_to_accept
business_rules.description: An offer moves Sent → Accepted or Sent → Expired, and it can be accepted only while it is still Sent and before its expiry time (five minutes after it was sent, configurable).
triggers: Receiver opens the offer detail page
Receiver presses Accept
Offer timeout passes with no response
side_effects: On timeout, Offer.status becomes expired and the matching cascade offers the listing to the next receiver
A StatusEvent records the offer expiry with time and system as actor
error_handling: Accept after expires_at: accept is refused and the page shows the offer has passed
Offer already withdrawn or superseded: page shows the offer is no longer available

business_rules.name: first_confirmed_claim_wins_atomically
business_rules.description: When two receivers accept the same listing at the same moment, the first confirmed write sets the listing to Claimed and the other receiver sees that it is already claimed.
triggers: Two receivers press Accept on offers for the same listing at nearly the same time
side_effects: The winning Offer.status becomes accepted and Listing.status becomes claimed
The losing offer's status becomes superseded
A StatusEvent records Posted or Offered → Claimed with the winning receiver as actor
error_handling: Losing receiver presses Accept: page shows the listing is already claimed and no change is made
Both writes race: the database enforces a single winner through an atomic update

business_rules.name: claim_requires_receiver_capacity_and_no_dietary_conflict
business_rules.description: A receiver can accept only if it can serve at least half of the listing quantity today and the listing contains no allergen or dietary conflict with the receiver's stated restrictions.
triggers: Receiver presses Accept on the offer detail page
side_effects: If both checks pass, the claim proceeds
If a check fails, the offer is not accepted and the listing returns to matching
error_handling: Quantity the receiver cannot serve today: accept is blocked and the page explains the capacity limit
Allergen or dietary conflict found (for example onion or garlic for a Jain kitchen): accept is blocked and the conflicting item is named

business_rules.name: allergens_must_be_shown_and_unknown_never_assumed_absent
business_rules.description: The handling card with allergen tags, consume-by time, storage guidance and the fixed disclaimer must be shown before a receiver can accept, and any allergen not confirmed by the donor is shown as "unknown — ask donor".
triggers: Receiver opens the offer detail page
Receiver presses Accept
side_effects: Receiver's acknowledgement of the handling card and allergens is recorded on the Offer with the time
The receiver is shown the unknown allergen status before accepting
error_handling: Listing has no handling card data: the Accept action is disabled and the page shows the card is missing
Allergen status is unknown: accept stays available but the "unknown — ask donor" label is shown and the receiver must acknowledge it

business_rules.name: volunteer_eta_must_beat_deadline_minus_buffer
business_rules.description: On claim, a volunteer is assigned with an ETA that must be earlier than the listing's consume-by time minus a 15-minute buffer; an ETA that would miss this is not accepted and the claim is re-offered.
triggers: Receiver accepts the offer and the system assigns a volunteer
Volunteer ETA is recalculated
side_effects: Offer.volunteer_id and Offer.eta_at are set when the ETA fits
If the ETA misses the buffer, the claim is re-offered and a StatusEvent records the re-offer
The donor and receiver see the assigned volunteer's masked name and ETA
error_handling: No volunteer available with an ETA inside the buffer: claim is not completed and the listing is re-offered to the next receiver, or expires if no time remains
ETA slips later than deadline minus 15 minutes after assignment: reassignment is triggered

business_rules.name: exact_pickup_point_revealed_only_to_assigned_volunteer
business_rules.description: The exact pickup point is shown only to the volunteer assigned to the claim; the receiver sees the zone and the volunteer's masked details, never the precise location.
triggers: Volunteer is assigned to a claimed listing
Receiver views the offer detail page after claim
side_effects: Receiver sees only Listing.pickup_zone_id and the volunteer's masked name and ETA
The exact pickup point is shown only in the assigned volunteer's view
error_handling: Non-assigned user requests the exact pickup point: the location is withheld and only the zone is shown

business_rules.name: every_claim_transition_is_logged
business_rules.description: Each change from Posted or Offered to Claimed, and each offer acceptance, expiry or re-offer, is recorded as a StatusEvent with the previous status, new status, actor and timestamp.
triggers: Receiver accepts an offer
Offer expires or is superseded
Volunteer is assigned to a claim
side_effects: A StatusEvent row is written for each change
The live status shown to donor, receiver and volunteer updates within 5 seconds
error_handling: Status write fails: the claim is rolled back so the listing is never Claimed without a logged event

validation_rules.description: Receiver must tick that they have read the handling card and allergens before the Accept action is enabled.
validation_rules.error_message: Please confirm you have read the handling card and allergens before accepting.

steps.description: Live board shows the listing as Claimed for all parties.

business_rules.name: listing_becomes_claimed_only_on_receiver_acceptance
business_rules.description: A listing moves from Offered to Claimed only when the receiver accepts the offer, following the path Posted → Offered → Claimed, and never through any other route.
triggers: Receiver accepts the offer for a listing
Receiver accepts and a volunteer is assigned with an ETA
side_effects: Listing.status becomes claimed
Offer.response is recorded as accepted
A StatusEvent is written with from_status offered and to_status claimed
The live status board shows the listing as Claimed for donor, receiver, volunteer and sponsor views
error_handling: If the offer has already timed out or been reassigned, the acceptance is rejected and the receiver sees that the offer is no longer open
If the listing is no longer in Offered (for example, Cancelled or Expired), the transition to Claimed is refused and the receiver is told the listing is unavailable

business_rules.name: claim_is_first_confirmed_write_wins
business_rules.description: When two receivers accept the same listing at the same moment, the first confirmed write sets the listing to Claimed and the other receiver is told it is already claimed.
triggers: Two receivers accept the same listing at the same moment
side_effects: Listing.status becomes claimed once, for the first confirmed receiver
The second receiver's Offer.response is recorded as lost to an existing claim
Both receivers are shown the listing as already claimed or claimed by the winner
error_handling: If the atomic update fails for the second receiver, no second StatusEvent to claimed is written
The losing receiver's acceptance is not counted toward match acceptance

business_rules.name: every_status_change_logged_with_time_and_actor
business_rules.description: Each change of a listing's status, including the change to Claimed, is recorded as a StatusEvent with the previous status, new status, actor and timestamp.
triggers: Listing status changes to Claimed
Any other listing status change occurs
side_effects: A StatusEvent row is stored for the Claimed transition with the receiver as actor
The event feeds the internal metrics page and the time-to-claim measurement
error_handling: If the StatusEvent cannot be written, the status change is rolled back so the board never shows a Claimed that is not logged
A missing actor is recorded as system rather than left blank

business_rules.name: live_board_reflects_claim_within_five_seconds
business_rules.description: The Claimed status appears on the live status board for all parties within 5 seconds of the receiver accepting.
triggers: Listing status changes to Claimed
A party opens or keeps open the live status board
side_effects: The donor, receiver, volunteer and sponsor views each show the listing as Claimed
The volunteer's assignment becomes visible on their view
error_handling: If a party's connection drops, the board re-reads the latest Listing.status on reconnect so the Claimed state is not missed
If the update is not delivered within 5 seconds, the board shows the last confirmed status with a 'syncing' indicator rather than a stale Claimed

business_rules.name: claim_must_meet_deadline_or_is_re_offered
business_rules.description: A claim is kept only if the volunteer's ETA lands before the consume-by deadline minus the 15-minute buffer; otherwise the listing is re-offered instead of staying Claimed.
triggers: Listing status changes to Claimed with a volunteer ETA
Volunteer ETA is recalculated after the claim
side_effects: If the ETA is acceptable, Listing.status stays claimed and the board shows Claimed
If the ETA would miss the deadline, Listing.status returns to offered and a new offer is sent to the next receiver
Donor and receiver are told the claim was re-offered
error_handling: If no next receiver can meet the deadline, the listing is expired and all parties are notified
A claim whose ETA cannot be computed is held as Claimed only until the next deadline check

steps.description: After delivery, receiver confirms the servings actually received; the listing becomes Delivered and an impact record is created.

business_rules.name: delivery_only_after_collection
business_rules.description: A listing can move to Delivered only from Collected, which in turn is reached only through a claimed offer (Posted → Offered → Claimed → Collected → Delivered).
triggers: Receiver submits the servings-received confirmation for a listing
Receiver opens the confirmation screen for a listing that is not yet Delivered
side_effects: Listing.status becomes Delivered only when the current status is Collected
A StatusEvent records the change from Collected to Delivered with the receiver as actor
If the listing is not Collected, the confirmation is refused and nothing changes
error_handling: Listing still Claimed or Offered: confirmation refused, receiver told the food has not been collected yet
Listing Expired or Cancelled: confirmation refused, receiver told the listing is closed and no impact is counted
Listing already Delivered: second confirmation refused, receiver shown the existing delivery

business_rules.name: delivered_quantity_is_receiver_confirmed_servings
business_rules.description: The servings the receiver confirms as actually received are stored as the delivered quantity, which may be less than the posted quantity.
triggers: Receiver enters the number of servings actually received
side_effects: ImpactRecord.servings is set to the receiver-confirmed value
The donor is told when the received servings are lower than the posted quantity
error_handling: Servings entered above the posted quantity: value rejected and receiver asked to correct it
Servings entered as zero: treated as a failed delivery, the receiver is asked to report a problem instead of confirming

business_rules.name: impact_record_created_on_delivery
business_rules.description: Confirming delivery creates exactly one ImpactRecord per listing, with meals computed as delivered kg divided by kg per meal from the current AssumptionSet.
triggers: Listing transitions from Collected to Delivered
side_effects: One ImpactRecord is created for the listing with delivered kg, servings, meals and CO2e
ImpactRecord.assumption_set_version is stamped with the AssumptionSet version used
The new impact appears in the donor weekly report and the sponsor dashboard
error_handling: Creating the ImpactRecord fails: the Delivered status is rolled back so the two stay consistent, and the receiver is asked to retry
An ImpactRecord already exists for the listing: no second record is created

business_rules.name: co2e_shown_only_with_cited_factor
business_rules.description: CO2e is calculated as delivered kg multiplied by the emission factor and shown only as an estimate range when the AssumptionSet holds a cited factor; otherwise it is left empty.
triggers: ImpactRecord is created during delivery confirmation
side_effects: ImpactRecord.co2e_kg is filled as a range estimate when the factor is present
ImpactRecord.co2e_kg is left empty and the view shows kg and meals only when the factor is missing
error_handling: Emission factor missing: CO2e left empty, no precise figure is ever shown

business_rules.name: expired_or_cancelled_never_counted
business_rules.description: Listings that are Expired or Cancelled never produce an ImpactRecord or count toward any impact figure.
triggers: Listing reaches Expired or Cancelled
Impact figures are computed for a report or dashboard
side_effects: No ImpactRecord is created for an expired or cancelled listing
Impact totals exclude these listings
error_handling: Delivery confirmation attempted on an expired listing: refused and no ImpactRecord created

business_rules.name: every_status_change_logged
business_rules.description: The move of a listing to Delivered is written as a StatusEvent with the previous status, new status, actor and time.
triggers: Listing status changes to Delivered
side_effects: A StatusEvent is recorded with the receiver User as actor
All parties' status views reflect Delivered within 5 seconds
error_handling: StatusEvent write fails: the status change is not committed

business_rules.name: delivery_confirmation_applied_once
business_rules.description: When two confirmations arrive for the same listing, only the first atomic update to Delivered succeeds; later attempts are rejected.
triggers: Receiver confirms delivery twice, or two devices confirm at the same moment
side_effects: Exactly one Delivered StatusEvent and one ImpactRecord exist for the listing
error_handling: Second confirmation: rejected with a message that the delivery is already recorded

validation_rules.description: The receiver must enter the number of servings actually received before delivery can be confirmed.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter the number of servings you actually received.

validation_rules.description: Servings received must be a whole number from 1 up to the listing's posted servings quantity.
validation_rules.error_message: Servings received must be between 1 and the posted quantity for this listing.

name: Volunteer Collects Food With Handover Code
description: A volunteer picks a nearby assigned pickup, arrives at the exact point, enters the donor's one-time code with the food temperature, and moves the listing to Collected and then Delivered.

steps.description: Volunteer signs in and selects the volunteer role.

business_rules.name: demo_sign_in_is_role_switcher_only
business_rules.description: For the MVP demo, signing in means choosing a role from a switcher, with no real credentials, and the chosen role is stored on the User record, while real sign-in is deferred to the hardening phase.
triggers: Visitor opens the login page and chooses a role to enter the app
side_effects: User.role is set to volunteer for this session
the user is taken to the volunteer view
error_handling: If no role is chosen, the user stays on the login page and is asked to choose one
If the chosen role is not one of the four app roles (donor, receiver, volunteer, sponsor), the role is rejected and nothing is changed

business_rules.name: volunteer_role_links_user_to_volunteer_profile
business_rules.description: Choosing the volunteer role links the User to a Volunteer record (zone, vehicle, availability windows) so that pickup tasks can be matched to that person.
triggers: Volunteer role is selected on the login page
side_effects: a Volunteer record is created for the User if none exists
the existing Volunteer record for the User is reused if one exists
the volunteer's zone is the one used for nearby task matching
error_handling: If the Volunteer record cannot be created, the role is not saved and the user is told to try again
If a User already has a Volunteer record, no second record is created

business_rules.name: volunteer_login_does_not_reveal_exact_pickup_point
business_rules.description: Signing in as a volunteer grants access to nearby tasks only as zone-level information, and the exact pickup point is revealed only once that volunteer is assigned to a listing.
triggers: Volunteer role is selected and the volunteer views available tasks
side_effects: volunteer sees listings by zone with jittered coordinates
the exact pickup point appears only for listings where the volunteer is assigned
error_handling: If a volunteer requests an exact pickup point for a listing not assigned to them, the request is refused and the attempt is logged

validation_rules.description: A role must be selected from the switcher before entering the app, and it must be one of donor, receiver, volunteer or sponsor.
validation_rules.error_message: Choose a role to continue.

steps.description: Volunteer sees assigned pickups sorted by nearness and time.

business_rules.name: volunteer_sees_only_own_assigned_pickups
business_rules.description: A volunteer's pickup list shows only the offers where they are the assigned volunteer and the claim is still active, and never shows another volunteer's pickups.
triggers: Volunteer opens the pickups page
Volunteer's pickup list refreshes after a status change
side_effects: The volunteer sees only their own active pickups on the list
Offers assigned to other volunteers are hidden from this volunteer
error_handling: If the volunteer has no assigned pickups, the page shows an empty state rather than other volunteers' pickups
If the volunteer's session does not match a Volunteer record, the page shows no pickups and asks them to sign in again

business_rules.name: pickups_sorted_by_nearness_then_time
business_rules.description: The volunteer's pickups are ordered by distance from the volunteer's zone, with the earlier pickup-by time used to decide ties, so the nearest and most urgent pickups come first.
triggers: Volunteer opens the pickups page
A new pickup is assigned to the volunteer and the list refreshes
