side_effects: Pickups are listed nearest first, using the zone-to-zone distance table
Pickups with the same zone distance are listed by earlier Listing.pickup_by
The distance shown for each pickup is taken from the zone-to-zone distance table, not from exact coordinates
error_handling: If the volunteer's zone or the donor's zone is missing, the pickup is listed last with a note that distance is unknown
If the distance table has no entry for a zone pair, the pickup is still listed, sorted by time only

business_rules.name: exact_pickup_point_revealed_only_to_assigned_volunteer
business_rules.description: The list shows only the donor's zone for each pickup; the exact pickup point is hidden until the volunteer is the assigned volunteer for that offer.
triggers: Volunteer opens the pickups page
Volunteer taps a pickup to see its details
side_effects: Non-assigned volunteers and other users see only the zone, never the exact point
The assigned volunteer sees the exact pickup point and the donor's masked contact
error_handling: If the offer is reassigned to another volunteer, the previous volunteer loses access to the exact pickup point on their next refresh
If the donor's exact point is unavailable, only the zone and masked contact are shown

business_rules.name: expired_or_cancelled_pickups_removed_from_list
business_rules.description: A pickup disappears from the volunteer's list once its listing is expired or cancelled, or once its consume-by deadline has passed, and it does not reappear.
triggers: Listing reaches its consume-by deadline and expires
Donor cancels a claimed listing
Volunteer's pickup list refreshes
side_effects: The expired or cancelled pickup is removed from the volunteer's list
The volunteer is told the pickup has been stood down or has expired
error_handling: If a status change is missed, the list corrects itself on the next refresh within 5 seconds
If a pickup expires while the volunteer is viewing it, its details show expired and handover is blocked

business_rules.name: reassigned_pickup_removed_from_previous_volunteer
business_rules.description: When a pickup is reassigned because the volunteer's ETA would miss the deadline, it is removed from the original volunteer's list and added to the new volunteer's list.
triggers: Volunteer ETA would be later than the consume-by deadline minus 15 minutes
Volunteer no-shows and the offer is reassigned
side_effects: The original volunteer's list drops the pickup
The new volunteer's list shows the pickup sorted by its position in nearness and time
The reassignment is logged with time and actor
error_handling: If no other volunteer is available, the pickup stays assigned and the escalation goes to the receiver or donor instead
If the original volunteer is already at the pickup, reassignment is not applied and the handover continues

steps.description: Volunteer opens the pickup, sees the exact point (revealed only to them), enters the donor's one-time code and records storage type and food temperature.

business_rules.name: collected_requires_correct_handover_code
business_rules.description: A listing moves from Claimed to Collected only after the assigned volunteer enters the donor's one-time handover code correctly (claimed → collected).
triggers: Volunteer enters the donor's one-time code on the pickup screen
Volunteer confirms handover at the donor's kitchen
side_effects: Listing.status becomes collected
a StatusEvent is recorded with the volunteer as actor and the time of handover
the donor and receiver see the listing as collected within 5 seconds
error_handling: Wrong code: Offer.handover_attempt_count increases and the volunteer sees that the code did not match; status stays claimed
Correct code but storage type or food temperature missing: Collected is blocked until both are recorded

business_rules.name: handover_locked_after_three_wrong_codes
business_rules.description: After three wrong handover code entries the handover is locked (Offer.handover_locked_at is set), an admin review is raised, and the donor is shown the volunteer's masked name to confirm in person.
triggers: Third consecutive wrong handover code entry on the same offer
side_effects: Offer.handover_locked_at is set and further code entry is refused
an admin review is raised for the listing
the donor sees the assigned volunteer's masked name to confirm in person
a StatusEvent records the lock with the volunteer as actor
error_handling: Further code attempts on a locked offer are refused with a message that the handover is under review
Admin cannot unlock without reviewing the listing; the listing is not moved to Collected by the lock itself

business_rules.name: storage_type_and_temperature_required_at_handover
business_rules.description: Storage type and food temperature must both be recorded on the listing before it can move from Claimed to Collected; a missing value blocks Collected.
triggers: Volunteer submits handover with the one-time code
Volunteer leaves storage type or food temperature empty
side_effects: Listing.storage_type and Listing.food_temperature_c are saved with the handover
Listing.status moves to collected only when both are present
error_handling: Missing food temperature: Collected is blocked and the volunteer is asked to enter it
Missing storage type: Collected is blocked and the volunteer is asked to choose it

business_rules.name: out_of_range_temperature_flags_listing_for_receiver
business_rules.description: A food temperature outside the handling rule table limit does not block handover; it sets Listing.temperature_flagged so the receiver decides whether to accept the food.
triggers: Volunteer enters a food temperature outside the rule table limit
side_effects: Listing.temperature_flagged becomes true
the volunteer sees a warning that the temperature is out of range
the receiver sees the flag on the listing before accepting the food
error_handling: If the temperature cannot be compared with the rule table, the listing is flagged for the receiver to decide rather than silently passed

business_rules.name: exact_pickup_point_revealed_only_to_assigned_volunteer
business_rules.description: The exact pickup point on a listing is visible only to the volunteer assigned on the offer; all other users see the zone only.
triggers: Volunteer opens the pickup detail page for an offer they hold
Any other user requests the listing's pickup location
side_effects: the assigned volunteer sees the exact pickup point
non-assigned users see only the zone
error_handling: A volunteer who is not assigned to the offer is denied the exact pickup point and sees the zone only
If the offer is reassigned, the previous volunteer loses access to the exact pickup point

business_rules.name: handover_code_checked_offline_and_synced_later
business_rules.description: When the volunteer is offline, the handover code is checked on the device and the handover is held as pending sync until the server confirms it.
triggers: Volunteer submits handover while the device has no connection
side_effects: Offer.sync_status is set to pending sync
the donor sees the handover as pending sync
Listing.status moves to collected only after the server confirms the handover
error_handling: If the server later rejects the synced handover, Offer.sync_status is reset and the volunteer is asked to re-enter the code

business_rules.name: handover_actions_logged_as_status_events
business_rules.description: Every handover change, including each collected transition, lock and pending sync, is logged as a StatusEvent with time and actor.
triggers: Listing moves to collected
Handover is locked after three wrong codes
Handover is marked pending sync
side_effects: a StatusEvent row is written with the volunteer as actor
the event appears on the live status board for all parties
error_handling: If the event cannot be written, the status change is not applied and the volunteer is asked to retry

validation_rules.description: The donor's one-time handover code must be entered before the listing can be marked collected.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter the donor's handover code to confirm pickup.

validation_rules.description: The entered handover code must match the one-time code issued to the donor for this offer exactly.
validation_rules.error_message: That code does not match. Check with the donor and try again. Three wrong attempts lock this handover.

validation_rules.description: Storage type must be chosen from the handling rule table options before handover is recorded.
validation_rules.error_message: Choose the storage type for this food.

validation_rules.description: Food temperature in degrees Celsius must be entered before the listing can be marked collected.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter the food temperature in °C to complete pickup.

validation_rules.description: Food temperature must be a plausible reading between -20 and 100 °C; readings outside the handling rule table limit are accepted but flagged.
validation_rules.error_message: This temperature looks wrong. Check the thermometer reading and enter it again.

steps.description: Volunteer marks the listing Collected, then Delivered after handing over to the receiver.

business_rules.name: collected_requires_correct_handover_code
business_rules.description: A listing moves from claimed → collected only when the volunteer enters the donor's one-time handover code correctly.
triggers: Volunteer enters the handover code on the pickup page and marks the listing Collected
side_effects: Listing.status becomes collected when the code matches
a StatusEvent is written recording claimed → collected, the volunteer as actor, and the time
the donor is told the food has been collected
the receiver is told the food has been collected
error_handling: Wrong code: Listing.status stays claimed and the attempt is counted
Code entered for a listing the volunteer is not assigned to: the attempt is rejected and not counted against the code

business_rules.name: collected_requires_storage_and_temperature
business_rules.description: A listing moves to collected only after the storage type and the food temperature at handover are both recorded (missing value → blocked).
triggers: Volunteer tries to mark the listing Collected
Volunteer submits the handover form without a temperature or storage type
side_effects: Listing.status moves to collected only once both values are stored
the volunteer is shown which value is missing
error_handling: Temperature missing: Collected is blocked and the listing stays claimed
Storage type missing: Collected is blocked and the listing stays claimed

business_rules.name: out_of_range_temperature_flags_listing_for_receiver
business_rules.description: A food temperature outside the rule-table range does not block collection; it flags the listing so the receiver decides whether to accept it.
triggers: Volunteer records a food temperature outside the allowed range during handover
side_effects: Listing.temperature_flagged is set to true
the receiver sees a temperature warning on the listing
the listing still moves to collected
error_handling: Value outside range: warning shown, listing flagged, collection continues
Value inside range: no flag is set

business_rules.name: status_advances_only_in_sequence
business_rules.description: A listing advances claimed → collected → delivered in that order, and delivery is reachable only through a claim.
triggers: Volunteer marks the listing Collected
Volunteer marks the listing Delivered
side_effects: Listing.status changes only to the next state in the sequence
an invalid jump is refused and no StatusEvent is written
error_handling: Attempt to mark Delivered from posted or offered: refused, the listing status is unchanged
Attempt to mark Delivered from collected a second time: refused as already delivered

business_rules.name: only_assigned_volunteer_can_mark_collected_or_delivered
business_rules.description: Only the volunteer assigned to the listing's accepted offer can mark the listing Collected or Delivered.
triggers: Any volunteer tries to mark a listing Collected or Delivered
side_effects: Listing.status changes only when the actor is the assigned volunteer
the unassigned attempt is logged
error_handling: Actor is not the assigned volunteer: action refused, status unchanged, attempt logged

business_rules.name: handover_locks_after_three_wrong_codes
business_rules.description: After three wrong handover code entries, the handover is locked for admin review (handover_attempt_count reaches 3 → handover_locked = true).
triggers: Volunteer enters a wrong handover code for the third time on a listing
side_effects: Listing.handover_locked is set to true and the listing waits for admin review
the donor is shown the volunteer's masked name to confirm in person
the admin is alerted to review the locked handover
the volunteer is told the handover is locked
error_handling: Further code entry on a locked listing: refused until the admin unlocks it

business_rules.name: delivery_blocked_past_consume_by_deadline
business_rules.description: A listing past its consume-by deadline cannot be marked delivered; it is expired instead (collected → expired at the deadline).
triggers: Volunteer marks the listing Delivered after the consume-by time has passed
The deadline passes while the listing is collected
side_effects: Listing.status becomes expired and is not counted as rescued
a StatusEvent is written with the expiry reason
the donor, receiver and volunteer are told the listing expired
error_handling: Delivered attempted after consume_by: refused and the listing is expired instead
Deadline passes mid-handover: the listing is expired and the volunteer is stood down

business_rules.name: every_status_change_is_logged
business_rules.description: Every status change to a listing writes a StatusEvent with the from state, to state, actor and timestamp.
triggers: Listing status changes to collected, delivered, expired or cancelled
side_effects: a timestamped StatusEvent is stored for the change
the status board and the measurement page can read the change
error_handling: Status change succeeds but the event write fails: the change is rolled back so status and log never disagree

business_rules.name: delivered_records_actual_quantity
business_rules.description: Marking a listing delivered records the actual quantity handed over, which may be less than the posted quantity.
triggers: Volunteer or receiver confirms the quantity handed over when marking Delivered
side_effects: Listing.delivered_quantity is stored as the actual amount
the donor is told the actual quantity received
error_handling: Delivered quantity greater than the posted quantity: refused
Delivered quantity less than posted: accepted and recorded as the actual figure

business_rules.name: delivery_creates_impact_record_with_assumption_version
business_rules.description: Marking a listing delivered creates an ImpactRecord from the delivered quantity, stamped with the current assumption version.
triggers: Listing status changes to delivered
side_effects: an ImpactRecord is created with meals computed from delivered kg and the stored kg-per-meal value
CO2e is stored as an estimate range using the stored emission factor
the impact view and weekly report can now include this delivery
error_handling: No current AssumptionSet exists: the ImpactRecord shows raw delivered kg only and is flagged for admin review

business_rules.name: offline_handover_pending_sync
business_rules.description: When the volunteer is offline, the code is checked on the device and the status change waits as pending sync until it reaches the server (offline → pending sync → synced).
triggers: Volunteer marks Collected or Delivered without network connection
side_effects: StatusEvent.sync_state is set to pending sync
the donor sees the listing as pending sync
on reconnect, the event is sent and sync_state becomes synced
error_handling: Offline code is wrong: refused on the device and counted toward the handover lock once synced
Sync fails after retries: the event stays pending sync and the admin is alerted

validation_rules.description: The handover code must be entered before the listing can be marked Collected.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter the handover code from the donor to mark this food as collected.

validation_rules.description: The handover code must match the length and character set of the one-time code issued for the listing.
validation_rules.error_message: The code must be the issued code for this listing. Check it with the donor and try again.

validation_rules.description: A storage type must be selected before the listing can be marked Collected.
validation_rules.error_message: Select how the food is stored before marking it as collected.

validation_rules.description: A food temperature in degrees Celsius must be recorded before the listing can be marked Collected.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter the food temperature at handover before marking it as collected.

validation_rules.description: The food temperature should fall within the range set in the rule table; outside it, a warning is shown and the listing is flagged, but collection is not blocked.
validation_rules.error_message: This temperature is outside the expected range. The receiver will be asked to decide whether to accept the food.

validation_rules.description: The delivered quantity must be zero or more and no greater than the quantity posted on the listing.
validation_rules.error_message: Delivered quantity cannot be more than the quantity posted for this listing.

steps.description: Live board logs each status change with time and actor.

business_rules.name: every_status_change_logged_with_time_and_actor
business_rules.description: Every change of a listing's status (Posted, Offered, Claimed, Collected, Delivered, Expired, Cancelled) writes one StatusEvent recording the previous status, the new status, the actor and the time.
triggers: A donor posts, edits or cancels a listing
The system offers a listing, cascades an offer or expires a listing at its deadline
A receiver claims a listing, cancels a claim or confirms delivered servings
A volunteer records the handover code and the listing is collected
side_effects: A new StatusEvent is written with the previous status, new status, actor and time
Listing.status is updated to the new status in the same operation, so the log and the listing never disagree
The status change is available to the live board and to the audit trail
error_handling: If the StatusEvent cannot be written, the Listing.status change is rolled back and the action fails with a retry message
If the actor is unknown, the event is rejected rather than logged without an actor
Duplicate transitions to the same status are not logged as new events

business_rules.name: listing_status_moves_only_along_allowed_transitions
business_rules.description: A listing's status moves only along the allowed path Posted → Offered → Claimed → Collected → Delivered, with the loops Claimed → Posted (receiver cancels) and Offered → Posted (offer times out to next match), and Posted, Offered or Claimed may move to Cancelled or Expired; Delivered is reached only through Collected and Collected only through Claimed.
triggers: A status change is requested by a donor, receiver, volunteer or the system
An offer times out and cascades to the next receiver
A listing reaches its consume-by deadline
side_effects: Listing.status changes only when the requested transition is allowed
A StatusEvent records the accepted transition
Affected parties are notified of the new status on the live board
error_handling: A disallowed transition (for example Posted → Delivered) is rejected and no StatusEvent is written
A transition requested on an already Expired or Cancelled listing is rejected with the listing's current status shown
If two actors request conflicting transitions at once, the first confirmed write wins and the other sees the current status

business_rules.name: status_changes_visible_to_all_parties_within_5_seconds
business_rules.description: Every status change recorded as a StatusEvent appears on the live status board of the donor, receiver and volunteer involved within 5 seconds.
triggers: A StatusEvent is written
A board is open for a listing the user is involved in
side_effects: The donor, assigned receiver and assigned volunteer see the new status on their live board
Staff can see the listing's current state without phoning
error_handling: If a live update cannot be delivered, the board shows the last known status with a stale-data notice and refreshes on reconnect
The board always reads the latest StatusEvent from the server so a missed update is corrected on the next poll

business_rules.name: deadline_and_expiry_transitions_run_server_side
business_rules.description: When a listing reaches its consume-by deadline while Posted, Offered or Claimed, the system moves it to Expired and logs the change with the system as actor, even if no user is online.
triggers: A listing's consume-by deadline passes
The server restarts while listings are open
side_effects: Listing.status becomes Expired
A StatusEvent records the expiry with the system as actor
Donor, receiver and volunteer see the expiry on the live board
error_handling: Expiry timers are rebuilt from the database on server start-up so no expiry is missed
A listing already Delivered or Cancelled is not expired

business_rules.name: status_event_log_is_append_only
business_rules.description: StatusEvent records are never edited or deleted; a correction is recorded as a new StatusEvent.
triggers: A user or admin attempts to change or remove an existing status event
A mistaken status change is reversed
side_effects: The original event remains in the log
The correction appears as a later StatusEvent with its own actor and time
error_handling: Edit or delete requests on a StatusEvent are rejected
Attempts to alter the log are recorded as an admin-visible incident

name: Donor Tracks and Cancels Own Listings
description: A caterer manager reviews their listings and their status, and cancels a listing while it is still Posted.

steps.description: Caterer manager signs in as a donor.

business_rules.name: demo_role_switch_sign_in
business_rules.description: In the MVP, a person signs in by choosing a demo role (caterer manager as donor) without a password, and real sign-in is deferred to a later phase.
triggers: Caterer manager selects the donor role on the login screen and continues
side_effects: A session is opened for the selected demo User with the donor role
The donor sees the donor views (post, listings, impact) for the session
error_handling: No role selected: the user stays on the login screen and is asked to choose a role
Selected demo account missing from seed data: sign-in is refused and the user is asked to reset demo data

business_rules.name: donor_session_scoped_to_own_listings
business_rules.description: A donor session shows only the listings belonging to that donor, never listings posted by other caterers.
triggers: Donor signs in as the caterer manager
Donor opens the listings or status view after sign-in
side_effects: Only the signed-in donor's Listings are returned to the donor view
Other donors' listings and their status are hidden from this session
error_handling: Session with donor role but no linked Donor record: the donor sees an empty listings view and a prompt to complete the donor profile

business_rules.name: sign_in_does_not_grant_posting_rights
business_rules.description: Signing in as a donor does not itself allow posting; posting is allowed only after the donor's FSSAI licence or registration number is verified.
triggers: Donor signs in and attempts to post a new listing
side_effects: Donor can view existing listings after sign-in regardless of verification status
Posting is blocked for unverified, expired or mismatched donors with a clear reason
error_handling: Donor without a verified FSSAI number tries to post: posting is blocked and the donor is told why
Donor's FSSAI status is checked by a mocked verification in the demo; no live lookup is run at sign-in

business_rules.name: synthetic_identity_only_on_user
business_rules.description: The User record for a demo sign-in holds only synthetic names and no real addresses or personal details.
triggers: Demo sign-in accounts are created or loaded from seed data
side_effects: Only generated names and zone-level identifiers are shown after sign-in
Contact details shown to other parties are masked
error_handling: A User record containing a real-looking phone number or address fails the seed check and is not loaded

validation_rules.description: A role must be chosen from the demo role list before sign-in can continue.
validation_rules.error_message: Please choose a role to sign in.

validation_rules.description: A demo account must be selected that exists in the seeded synthetic user list for the chosen role.
validation_rules.error_message: Select a demo account for this role to continue.

steps.description: Listings page shows the donor's own posts with status and consume-by time.

business_rules.name: donor_sees_only_own_listings
business_rules.description: A donor's listings page shows only the listings that donor posted, never another donor's listings.
triggers: Donor opens the listings page
Donor refreshes the listings page
side_effects: The page lists only the signed-in donor's Listing records, newest first
error_handling: If the donor has no listings, the page shows an empty state with a prompt to post a first listing
If a listing belongs to another donor, it is excluded from the results rather than shown with an error

business_rules.name: listing_status_shown_per_lifecycle
business_rules.description: Each listing shows its current status from the lifecycle Posted → Offered → Claimed → Collected → Delivered, with Expired and Cancelled as terminal outcomes.
triggers: Donor opens the listings page
A listing changes status while the donor is viewing the page
side_effects: Each listing card displays its Listing.status label
The status shown matches the latest StatusEvent for that listing
error_handling: If a listing's status cannot be read, the card shows 'status unavailable' and the rest of the list still loads

business_rules.name: consume_by_deadline_shown_on_every_listing
business_rules.description: Each listing shows its consume-by deadline, which is the earlier of the donor's pickup-by time and the rule-table limit.
triggers: Donor opens the listings page
A listing is posted and appears on the page
side_effects: Each listing card shows the consume-by time in local time
Listings whose consume-by has passed are shown with their Expired status instead of an active deadline
error_handling: If consume_by is missing, the listing is not shown as active and is flagged for review rather than displaying a guessed deadline

business_rules.name: expired_listings_marked_at_deadline
business_rules.description: A listing still unclaimed or undelivered at its consume-by deadline moves to Expired and is displayed as such.
triggers: Consume-by deadline passes while the listing is Posted, Offered or Claimed without delivery
Donor opens the listings page after the deadline has passed
side_effects: Listing.status becomes Expired
A StatusEvent is recorded with the time and actor 'system'
The donor sees the listing marked Expired on the page
error_handling: If the expiry job was missed (for example after a server restart), the status is corrected on the next load and the correction is logged

business_rules.name: cancel_action_only_while_posted
business_rules.description: The cancel control appears on a listing only while its status is Posted; once Offered, Claimed, Collected, Delivered, Expired or Cancelled, it is not offered.
triggers: Donor views a listing card with status Posted
Donor views a listing whose status has moved past Posted
side_effects: Cancel control is shown only for Posted listings
Listings in any other status show no cancel control
error_handling: If the status changes to Offered between page load and click, the cancel request is rejected and the donor is told the listing is already being matched

business_rules.name: status_changes_visible_within_five_seconds
business_rules.description: Changes to a listing's status appear on the donor's listings page within 5 seconds of the change.
triggers: A listing's status changes while the donor is on the listings page
A receiver, volunteer or the system changes a listing's status
side_effects: The listing card updates its status label without a manual reload
error_handling: If live updates fail, the page falls back to a periodic refresh and shows a 'last updated' time

steps.description: Donor opens a Posted listing and cancels it; status becomes Cancelled and the change is logged.

business_rules.name: donor_can_cancel_only_posted_listing
business_rules.description: A donor can cancel their own listing only while it is Posted, moving it from Posted → Cancelled.
triggers: Donor selects Cancel listing on the listing detail page for a listing in Posted status
side_effects: Listing.status becomes cancelled
a StatusEvent is recorded with from_status posted and to_status cancelled
the listing is removed from the matching pipeline
error_handling: Listing is not owned by the requesting donor: cancel is refused and the donor sees that they cannot change this listing
Listing is in any status other than Posted (for example Offered, Claimed, Collected, Delivered, Expired or already Cancelled): cancel is refused and the donor is told the current status
Listing status was changed by another action between the page load and the cancel: the cancel is rejected, the donor sees the latest status, and nothing is written

business_rules.name: cancellation_is_logged_with_actor_and_time
business_rules.description: Every cancellation writes a StatusEvent with the listing, the from and to status, the acting donor and the timestamp, in the same transaction as the status change.
triggers: A Posted listing is successfully cancelled by its donor
side_effects: a StatusEvent row is stored showing posted → cancelled, the donor as actor and the time
the event feeds the internal metrics page and the funnel counts for cancelled listings
error_handling: StatusEvent write fails: the Listing.status change is rolled back so the listing does not show Cancelled without a log entry
Status change succeeds but the page fails to refresh: the donor sees the Cancelled status on next load because the change is stored

business_rules.name: cancelled_listing_stops_offers_and_impact
business_rules.description: A Cancelled listing is terminal: it is never offered, matched or claimed afterwards, and it never counts toward impact numbers.
triggers: A listing's status becomes Cancelled
Matching or coordination runs for a listing that is Cancelled
side_effects: no Offer is created for the listing after cancellation
the listing is excluded from delivered, meals and CO2e totals shown in the impact view
a receiver who opens the listing sees it as no longer available
error_handling: Matching job runs on a listing cancelled a moment earlier: the job checks status before sending and skips the listing
Receiver claim arrives after cancellation: the claim is refused with a message that the listing is no longer available

business_rules.name: cancel_uses_atomic_status_update
business_rules.description: The Posted → Cancelled change is applied as a single conditional update so that a simultaneous claim or offer cannot be overwritten.
triggers: Donor confirms cancellation at the same moment a receiver claims or the system sends an offer
side_effects: whichever action commits first sets the listing status
the losing action is told the listing has already changed
error_handling: Cancel loses the race to a claim: the donor is told the listing was claimed and that cancellation now follows the claimed-listing flow
Cancel loses the race to an offer: the donor is told the listing is now Offered and cancellation is unavailable

steps.description: Live board shows the cancelled listing alongside other rescues.

business_rules.name: cancelled_listing_shown_on_live_board
business_rules.description: A cancelled listing stays visible on the live status board, labelled Cancelled, alongside the other rescues in progress (states: posted → offered → claimed → collected → delivered, with expired or cancelled as end states).
triggers: A donor cancels a listing
A viewer opens or refreshes the live status board
side_effects: Listing.status becomes cancelled
The board shows the cancelled listing with a Cancelled label next to the other listings, with no offer or pickup action left available on it
Donor, receiver and volunteer views all show the Cancelled state
error_handling: If the listing has no StatusEvent row for its cancellation, the board shows the listing's current status but the change is flagged to the admin for review
If a listing is cancelled while a volunteer is assigned, the board still shows it as Cancelled rather than removing it

business_rules.name: status_change_propagated_to_all_parties_within_5_seconds
business_rules.description: A cancellation is written as a StatusEvent and reflected on every party's view within 5 seconds (posted → offered → claimed → collected → delivered, with expired or cancelled as end states).
triggers: A Listing status change is recorded as a StatusEvent
side_effects: The board and each party's view update to the new Listing.status within 5 seconds
The receiver and volunteer see the change on their own screens
error_handling: If the update does not reach a viewer within 5 seconds, the board refetches the listing's status on the next poll and shows the latest StatusEvent
If the write to StatusEvent fails, the Listing.status change is rolled back so the board never shows a status with no log

business_rules.name: every_status_change_logged_with_actor_and_time
business_rules.description: Every change to a listing's status, including a cancellation, is logged as a StatusEvent with the previous status, new status, the actor who made it and the time.
triggers: A donor cancels a listing
A system process changes a listing's status (for example, expiry at the deadline)
side_effects: A StatusEvent row is stored for the cancellation with the donor's id as actor and the cancellation time
The event is available to the funnel metrics and the internal metrics page
error_handling: If the actor is unknown, the actor is recorded as system with a flag for review
A status change without a matching StatusEvent is rejected and not applied

business_rules.name: cancellation_excluded_from_impact_and_rescue_rate
business_rules.description: A cancelled listing never counts as posted food in the impact figures or the rescue-rate metric, and it never produces an ImpactRecord.
triggers: A donor cancels a listing
Impact figures or the rescue-rate metric are calculated from StatusEvent rows
side_effects: No ImpactRecord is created for the cancelled listing
The impact view and the rescue-rate metric exclude the cancelled listing from totals
error_handling: If an ImpactRecord already exists for a listing that is then cancelled, the record is excluded from totals and flagged for admin review
If delivered kg is missing for a cancelled listing, no meals or CO2e are calculated

business_rules.name: donor_cancellation_rules_by_listing_state
business_rules.description: A donor can cancel a listing while it is posted; a cancellation after a receiver has claimed it moves it to cancelled and stands down the volunteer, and the receiver is told.
triggers: A donor cancels a listing that is posted
A donor cancels a listing that a receiver has already claimed
side_effects: Listing.status becomes cancelled
The assigned volunteer is stood down and no longer shown the pickup
The receiver is told the listing was cancelled
The cancellation appears as a StatusEvent
error_handling: If the listing is already collected or delivered, cancellation is refused with a message that the food has already left
If the listing is already expired, cancellation is refused because it is no longer active
If the donor and listing owner do not match, cancellation is refused

name: Donor Receives Weekly Impact Report
description: Each week the donor gets a report where code calculates the numbers, the LLM writes the wording, a code check verifies it, and the donor reads it and downloads the donation records.

steps.description: Caterer manager opens the home page and sees the weekly report is ready.

business_rules.name: weekly_report_shown_only_when_donor_had_delivery
business_rules.description: A caterer manager sees a weekly impact report ready on the home page only when their donor account had at least one delivered listing in that week.
triggers: Caterer manager opens the home page
The weekly report generation has run for the past week
side_effects: The home page shows a 'weekly report ready' card linking to the report
No card is shown to a donor with no deliveries that week
error_handling: No delivered listings this week: no report card is shown and no empty report is created
User is not linked to a donor account: the report card is hidden
Report generation for the week has not run yet: the card shows 'report being prepared' with no numbers

business_rules.name: report_counts_only_delivered_listings
business_rules.description: The weekly report counts only listings whose status is delivered, and never counts posted, offered, expired or cancelled listings.
triggers: Weekly report is generated for a donor
A listing's status changes to delivered, expired or cancelled
side_effects: ImpactRecord totals for the donor's week are computed from delivered listings only
Expired and cancelled listings add nothing to the weekly figures shown on the home page
error_handling: A listing is delivered but has no ImpactRecord: it is flagged for review and excluded from the displayed totals until the record exists
Listing changes to expired after the report was generated: the report is regenerated on the next weekly run, not edited on the fly

business_rules.name: report_numbers_use_delivered_quantity_and_stated_assumptions
business_rules.description: Each number in the weekly report is derived from delivered quantity and is shown with the assumption set version it was calculated with (for example, meals = delivered kg ÷ kg per meal).
triggers: Weekly report is generated
Caterer manager views the report summary on the home page
side_effects: The home page summary states the assumption version used
Each figure links to 'how we calculate this' with its formula
error_handling: Emission factor not yet cited: CO2e is omitted and only kg and meals are shown
Assumption version missing for a record: the record is not counted until a version is attached

business_rules.name: report_wording_must_match_computed_values
business_rules.description: The report sentences are checked so every number in the text equals the computed value, and any mismatch or banned claim causes the plain template to be shown instead.
triggers: AI generates report wording for the week
Code check runs on the generated report text before display
side_effects: The verified wording or the plain template is stored with the week's report
Any discarded AI output is logged for the admin to review
error_handling: A number in the wording differs from the computed value: the wording is discarded and the plain template is used
Banned words such as 'safe', 'certified', 'tax benefit' or '80G' appear: the output is discarded, logged and the template is shown
AI call exceeds 5 seconds or returns invalid output after one retry: the template is used with no delay

business_rules.name: report_generated_once_per_week_and_reused
business_rules.description: The weekly donor report is generated once per donor per week on a schedule and stored, and the home page reuses the stored report rather than regenerating it on each view.
triggers: Scheduled weekly report run completes
Caterer manager opens the home page
side_effects: One stored weekly report per donor is available to the home page
No new AI call is made when the home page is opened
error_handling: Scheduled run fails for a donor: the run is retried later and the home page shows 'report being prepared'
Viewing the page during a run: the most recent stored report is shown

business_rules.name: report_shows_only_to_owning_donor
business_rules.description: A donor's weekly report is visible only to users linked to that donor account, and no other donor's figures appear on the home page.
triggers: Caterer manager opens the home page
A user switches role in the demo
side_effects: Home page loads only the signed-in user's donor report
Access attempts for another donor's report are refused
error_handling: User has no linked donor: no report card is shown
Requested report belongs to a different donor: the request is refused and logged

steps.description: Report service takes code-computed meals, kg and CO2e with the assumption version, asks the LLM for sentences only, and falls back to a template if a number or banned word fails the check.

business_rules.name: report_numbers_computed_by_code_only
business_rules.description: Meals, delivered kg and CO2e are calculated by code from delivered ImpactRecords and the active AssumptionSet before any wording is requested, and the language model never computes or changes them.
triggers: Weekly report generation for a donor who had at least one delivery that week
Report request for a donor's impact view
side_effects: ImpactRecord.meals, ImpactRecord.co2e_kg and ImpactRecord.assumption_version are set from the code calculation
the computed values are passed to the wording step as the only permitted numbers
error_handling: If the AssumptionSet version for an ImpactRecord is missing, the report is not generated and the admin is told the assumption set is incomplete
If a delivered ImpactRecord has no kg value, it is excluded from totals and the gap is logged

business_rules.name: impact_counts_only_delivered_listings
business_rules.description: Report totals include only ImpactRecords whose Listing reached delivered status, using the delivered quantity and never the posted quantity, and never expired or cancelled listings.
triggers: Weekly report generation
Sponsor dashboard totals per zone and per week
side_effects: expired and cancelled listings are left out of the weekly totals
the report shows delivered kg and servings only
error_handling: If a listing is marked delivered but has no ImpactRecord, it is left out of totals and flagged for admin review
If delivered quantity is lower than posted quantity, the actual delivered figure is used

business_rules.name: number_match_check_before_showing_text
business_rules.description: Before any language-model text is shown, every number in it must equal a computed value from the ImpactRecord or AssumptionSet, with no hedged or approximate figures such as 'about 100 meals'.
triggers: Language model returns report sentences
Donor or sponsor opens a weekly report
side_effects: if all numbers match, the model text is shown with the report
if any number does not match, the model text is discarded and the template report is shown instead
error_handling: Any number in the text that differs from the computed value causes the template fallback
A missing computed value causes the template fallback
The discarded text and the mismatch are logged for review

business_rules.name: banned_wording_check_before_showing_text
business_rules.description: Generated report text is scanned against the banned-claim list, including safety words ('safe', 'certified', 'guaranteed fresh') and tax or legal words ('tax deduction', '80G', 'tax benefit', 'legal protection', 'liability-free'), and any match blocks the text.
triggers: Language model returns report sentences
Injected instruction is detected in the model output
side_effects: text with a banned word is discarded and the template report is used
the attempt is logged with the ImpactRecord references for the admin
error_handling: Banned word found: discard the model text, use the template, log the case, tell the admin
Injected instruction found in output: discard, log, use the template

business_rules.name: language_model_writes_sentences_only
business_rules.description: The Anthropic model (anthropic) is given the code-computed values and asked only for the sentences around them, with the fixed disclaimer carried over unchanged and no new figures or claims.
triggers: Weekly report generation for a donor with deliveries that week
Sponsor summary request for a zone
side_effects: the model returns wording that is checked before display
the report shows the fixed disclaimer 'Not certified safe — follow handling guidance'
error_handling: Model call exceeds 5 seconds: stop waiting and use the template
Model returns invalid output after one retry: use the template

business_rules.name: template_report_fallback
business_rules.description: When the model text fails a check, times out, or returns invalid output after one retry, the plain template report is shown with the same code-computed numbers and the assumption version.
triggers: Number check fails
Banned word check fails
Model call times out after 5 seconds
Model returns invalid output after one retry
side_effects: the donor or sponsor sees the template report without delay
the report states the AssumptionSet version it used
error_handling: If CO2e is unavailable because the emission factor is missing, the template shows delivered kg and meals only
If the template itself cannot compute a value, the report shows raw delivered kg only

business_rules.name: report_states_assumption_version
business_rules.description: Every weekly report shows each number with the AssumptionSet version it was computed from and a 'how we calculate this' note, and CO2e is shown as an estimate range.
triggers: Any weekly report is rendered, whether model text or template
side_effects: the report includes the assumption version and formula for each number
CO2e appears as an estimate range rather than a precise figure
error_handling: An ImpactRecord without an assumption version is not included in the report and is flagged

business_rules.name: weekly_report_generated_once_and_cached
business_rules.description: Each donor's weekly report is generated once for the week and reused on later views, so the model is not called on every page load.
triggers: Donor opens the weekly report for a week already generated
Scheduled weekly report run for the week ending
side_effects: the generated report is stored for the donor and week
a later change to delivered records triggers regeneration for that week only
error_handling: If storing the report fails, the report is still shown from a fresh generation and the failure is logged

business_rules.name: no_report_for_donor_without_deliveries
business_rules.description: A weekly report is generated only for a donor with at least one delivered listing in that week; weeks with no deliveries get no report and no model call.
triggers: Scheduled weekly report run
Donor opens the weekly report for a week with no deliveries
side_effects: no report is created for the donor for that week
the donor sees a plain note that no food was delivered that week
error_handling: If the donor has only expired listings in the week, no report is generated and no model call is made

steps.description: Donor reads the weekly report of delivered rescues with the assumptions used and shares it with clients.

business_rules.name: report_counts_only_delivered_listings
business_rules.description: The weekly report includes only listings whose status reached delivered, and never counts posted, offered, expired or cancelled listings.
triggers: Donor opens the weekly impact report page
Weekly report is generated at the end of the reporting week
side_effects: Only delivered listings contribute ImpactRecord rows to the report totals
Expired and cancelled listings are excluded from every total on the report
error_handling: A listing whose status is not delivered is left out of totals without an error
If a delivered listing has no ImpactRecord, the report flags it for admin review and does not count it silently

business_rules.name: report_uses_delivered_quantity_not_posted
business_rules.description: All quantities on the report (kg, servings, meals) are based on the delivered actual quantity recorded by the receiver, not the quantity originally posted.
triggers: Donor opens the weekly impact report page
Receiver confirms servings received at delivery
side_effects: ImpactRecord.delivered_kg and ImpactRecord.servings hold the actual received quantities
ImpactRecord.meals is derived from the delivered kg, so the meal count shown on the report reflects what was actually received
error_handling: If a receiver delivers less than posted, the report shows the lower actual figure with no warning to the donor beyond the delivered amount
If no delivered quantity has been recorded for a delivered listing, that listing is excluded from totals and flagged

business_rules.name: report_shows_assumption_set_used
business_rules.description: Every computed number on the report is shown with the AssumptionSet version and the values (kg per meal, emission factor) used to calculate it.
triggers: Donor opens the weekly impact report page
Donor selects 'how we calculate this' beside a number
side_effects: The report displays the formula and the assumption version beside meals, kg and CO2e
Each ImpactRecord stores the AssumptionSet version it was calculated with
error_handling: If an ImpactRecord has no assumption set reference, its numbers are not shown and the report says the calculation basis is missing
If the emission factor is not yet cited, CO2e is hidden and only kg and meals are shown

business_rules.name: meals_derived_from_kg_per_meal
business_rules.description: Meals saved are computed as delivered kg divided by the kg per meal value of the active AssumptionSet, and CO2e avoided as delivered kg multiplied by the emission factor, with all values computed by code.
triggers: Weekly report is generated
AssumptionSet values are changed by admin
side_effects: ImpactRecord.meals and ImpactRecord.co2e_kg are stored with the AssumptionSet version used
A new AssumptionSet version applies only to reports generated after the change
error_handling: If kg per meal is missing or zero, meals are not computed and the report shows delivered kg only
If the emission factor is missing, CO2e is not computed and shown as unavailable

business_rules.name: report_generated_weekly_and_only_with_deliveries
business_rules.description: A donor's weekly impact report is generated once per week, and only for a donor who had at least one delivered listing that week; otherwise a no-deliveries message is shown instead.
triggers: Weekly report generation runs at the end of the reporting week
Donor opens the report for a week with no deliveries
side_effects: A stored weekly report is created for each donor with at least one delivery
Donors with no deliveries that week see a plain message and no impact figures
error_handling: A week with no deliveries produces no impact totals and no AI-written text
If generation fails, the donor sees the last successful report with its date

business_rules.name: report_text_passes_number_and_claim_check
business_rules.description: The report wording is checked by code so that every number in the text matches the computed values and no banned claim appears; on any mismatch the report uses a plain template instead.
triggers: AI writes the report wording around computed numbers
Report is opened or shared by the donor
side_effects: AI-written wording is discarded and the plain template is shown when a check fails
The failed case is logged and the admin is notified
error_handling: A number mismatch causes the template to be shown; a wrong number is never displayed
A banned word (such as tax, 80G, safe or certified) causes the output to be discarded
If the AI is slow or returns invalid output after one retry, the template is shown with no delay

business_rules.name: report_carries_fixed_food_safety_disclaimer
business_rules.description: Every weekly report, including any version shared with clients, displays the fixed disclaimer 'Not certified safe — follow handling guidance' and contains no wording that says the food is safe or certified.
triggers: Donor opens the weekly impact report page
Donor shares the report with clients
side_effects: The disclaimer is rendered on the report and on the shared copy
The shared copy goes to client recipients with the disclaimer included
error_handling: If the disclaimer cannot be rendered, the report is not shown or shared
Any text containing a banned safety word is removed and the template is used

business_rules.name: report_excludes_tax_and_legal_claims
business_rules.description: The report and its shared copy never mention tax, legal or liability benefits, and any generated text is blocked if it contains such terms.
triggers: AI writes report wording
Donor shares the report with clients
side_effects: Report text containing blocked terms is replaced by the plain template
The blocked attempt is logged for admin review
error_handling: Output containing a blocked term such as 'tax deduction', '80G', 'tax benefit', 'legal protection' or 'liability-free' is discarded
The template is shown instead and the admin is informed

business_rules.name: report_records_downloadable_for_donor
business_rules.description: The donor can view the underlying delivery records for each number on the report, so each figure can be traced to its listings.
triggers: Donor selects the delivery records behind a report number
side_effects: The donor sees only the listings belonging to their own donor account
error_handling: A donor cannot view ImpactRecords belonging to another donor; the request is refused

steps.description: Donor opens a delivered listing and downloads its donation record.

business_rules.name: donation_record_available_only_for_delivered_listing
business_rules.description: A donation record can be downloaded only once its listing has reached delivered (posted → offered → claimed → collected → delivered); posted, expired and cancelled listings have no downloadable record.
triggers: Donor opens a listing's detail page
Donor requests the download of a listing's donation record
side_effects: Download action is enabled on the listing when Listing.status is delivered
For any other status the download action is hidden and the page explains that the record becomes available after delivery
error_handling: Listing not yet delivered: download is disabled with the message 'Record available after delivery'
Listing expired or cancelled: no record is generated and the page states that no impact is counted for it
Listing delivered but no ImpactRecord exists yet: download is blocked and the gap is reported to the admin for review

business_rules.name: donation_record_contains_all_required_fields
business_rules.description: Every donation record includes donor, date, items, quantity, prep time, consume-by time, storage and food temperature, quantity distributed, and area, and is complete for 100% of delivered listings.
triggers: Donor downloads a delivered listing's donation record
A listing reaches delivered
side_effects: The donation record is assembled from the listing and its ImpactRecord
The record date is the timestamp of the delivered status event
Quantity distributed is the actual delivered quantity recorded by the receiver
error_handling: A required field is missing on a delivered listing: the record is not produced as complete and the admin is alerted to fix the source data
Food temperature missing: the record cannot be completed because collection should have been blocked without it

business_rules.name: donation_record_visible_only_to_listing_donor
business_rules.description: Only the donor who posted a listing can open its detail page and download its donation record.
triggers: A user opens a listing detail page
A user requests the donation record download
side_effects: The page and download are shown to the owning donor only
error_handling: A different user tries to open or download the record: access is refused and the listing is not revealed
A user whose donor account is paused or unverified: download is blocked with the reason

business_rules.name: donation_record_reports_delivered_quantity_with_assumption_version
business_rules.description: The quantity shown in the donation record is the delivered quantity, not the posted quantity, and the impact figures on the record state the assumption version used.
triggers: A donation record is generated for a delivered listing
side_effects: Record shows delivered kg and servings as the distributed quantity
Record shows the posted quantity only as context, labelled as posted
Record shows the assumption version beside any meals or CO2e figure
error_handling: Delivered kg differs from posted quantity: the record uses the delivered figure and notes the difference
Assumption version missing on an ImpactRecord: the impact figures are shown as raw delivered kg only

business_rules.name: donation_record_carries_fixed_disclaimer_and_banned_claims_blocked
business_rules.description: Every donation record shows the fixed disclaimer 'Not certified safe — follow handling guidance' and contains no wording that calls the food safe or certified or implies tax, legal or liability benefits.
triggers: A donation record is generated or rendered for download
side_effects: The fixed disclaimer is printed on the record
Generated text is scanned for banned words before the record is offered for download
error_handling: A banned word is found in generated text: the text is replaced by the plain template and the case is logged for the admin
Disclaimer text missing: the record is not offered for download

business_rules.name: donation_record_shows_zone_not_exact_pickup_point
business_rules.description: The donation record identifies the listing's area by zone only; the exact pickup point is never included.
triggers: A donation record is generated for download
side_effects: The record shows the zone name and no street address or exact coordinates
error_handling: Exact address or coordinates found in the record data: they are stripped before generation and the incident is logged

name: Sponsor Reviews Zone Impact
description: A CSR sponsor signs in, reviews impact totals by zone and week, and drills into each rescue's numbers with their assumptions and version.

steps.description: CSR sponsor signs in and selects the sponsor role.

business_rules.name: demo_role_switch_sets_sponsor_role
business_rules.description: In the MVP, selecting the sponsor role on the login page sets the signed-in User's role to sponsor and opens the sponsor view, with no real credential check.
triggers: CSR sponsor selects the sponsor role on the login page
side_effects: User.role becomes sponsor for the current session
the sponsor dashboard by zone becomes the user's landing view
error_handling: If no role is selected, the user stays on the login page and is asked to choose a role
If the selected role is not one of the defined roles, the role is not set and the user stays on the login page

business_rules.name: sponsor_role_is_read_only_on_impact_data
business_rules.description: A User with the sponsor role may view zone-level impact and assumptions but cannot post, claim, offer, or change any listing or status.
triggers: a User with the sponsor role lands on the sponsor view after role selection
side_effects: sponsor sees zone-level impact figures with the AssumptionSet version they used
no Listing or StatusEvent is created or changed by a sponsor session
error_handling: If a sponsor session attempts a donor, receiver or volunteer action, the action is refused and the sponsor is told the role cannot perform it

business_rules.name: sponsor_sees_zone_level_data_only
business_rules.description: A sponsor session shows impact by zone ID and never exposes exact addresses, pickup points or unmasked contact details.
triggers: a User with the sponsor role opens the sponsor dashboard
side_effects: sponsor dashboard shows zone IDs and aggregated totals only
masked contact values and exact pickup points are withheld from the sponsor view
error_handling: If a zone-level record lacks a zone ID, it is excluded from the sponsor totals and not shown as an unlabelled figure

validation_rules.description: A role must be selected from the defined roles before the user can enter the app.
validation_rules.error_message: Please select a role to continue.

steps.description: Home prompts the sponsor to open the sponsor dashboard.

business_rules.name: sponsor_home_prompt_is_read_only
business_rules.description: The home page prompt that sends a CSR sponsor to the sponsor dashboard changes no stored records and shows no impact figures itself, so every number the sponsor sees comes from the dashboard's own calculation.
triggers: A sponsor opens the home page
The sponsor taps or clicks the prompt to open the sponsor dashboard
side_effects: No Listing, ImpactRecord, AssumptionSet or StatusEvent is created or changed
The sponsor is taken to the sponsor dashboard, where zone-level impact is computed and shown with its assumptions
error_handling: If the sponsor dashboard cannot load, the home prompt stays visible and shows a plain message that the dashboard is unavailable; no partial numbers are shown
If the sponsor's role cannot be determined under the MVP role switcher, the sponsor is asked to choose the sponsor role before entering the dashboard

steps.description: Dashboard shows totals per zone and per week, plus quarterly summaries for sponsored zones.

business_rules.name: sponsor_dashboard_totals_by_zone_and_week
business_rules.description: The sponsor dashboard totals delivered rescues per zone and per week, grouping each ImpactRecord by its zone and by the week of its delivery.
triggers: A sponsor opens the sponsor dashboard
A sponsor changes the zone or date range shown on the dashboard
side_effects: The dashboard shows delivered kg, servings, meals and CO2e totals for each zone and each week
No ImpactRecord is created or changed by viewing the dashboard
error_handling: A zone with no delivered listings in the period shows zero totals rather than being hidden
A week with no deliveries shows zero totals and is not dropped from the weekly series
An ImpactRecord missing its zone is excluded from zone totals and reported as unassigned, not guessed

business_rules.name: impact_counts_only_delivered_listings
business_rules.description: Only ImpactRecords whose linked Listing reached delivered status count toward dashboard totals; posted, offered, claimed, expired and cancelled listings are never counted.
triggers: Dashboard totals are calculated
A listing transitions to expired or cancelled after an ImpactRecord was drafted
side_effects: Expired or cancelled listings are left out of every zone and weekly total
The dashboard totals change when a listing's status changes to expired or cancelled
error_handling: An ImpactRecord whose listing is expired or cancelled is excluded and flagged for review rather than deleted
A listing with no delivered quantity recorded is excluded from kg totals instead of being counted as zero-filled food

business_rules.name: sponsor_quarterly_summary_for_sponsored_zones_only
business_rules.description: Quarterly summaries are produced only for the zones a sponsor sponsors, rolling up the delivered ImpactRecords of each quarter for those zones.
triggers: A sponsor opens the quarterly summary section
A quarter closes and its summary is requested
side_effects: The sponsor sees one quarterly summary per sponsored zone with delivered kg, meals and CO2e for that quarter
Zones the sponsor does not sponsor are not shown in the quarterly summary
error_handling: A sponsor with no sponsored zones sees an empty state explaining that no zones are sponsored yet
A sponsored zone with no deliveries in a quarter shows a zero summary for that quarter

business_rules.name: meals_and_co2e_computed_from_delivered_quantity_and_versioned_assumptions
business_rules.description: Dashboard meals are delivered kg divided by the kg-per-meal assumption and CO2e is delivered kg multiplied by the emission factor, both taken from the assumption version recorded on each ImpactRecord.
triggers: An ImpactRecord is created when a listing is delivered
The dashboard totals are calculated
side_effects: Each ImpactRecord stores the assumption version used to calculate its meals and CO2e
Dashboard totals reflect the assumption version recorded on each underlying ImpactRecord
error_handling: An ImpactRecord with no assumption version is not used for meals or CO2e and only its raw delivered kg is shown
If the emission factor is not yet cited, CO2e is hidden on the dashboard and only kg and meals are shown

business_rules.name: dashboard_shows_assumptions_and_calculation_notes_beside_every_number
business_rules.description: Every total on the sponsor dashboard shows its assumption version and a 'how we calculate this' note, and CO2e is displayed as an estimate range rather than a precise figure.
triggers: A sponsor views any total on the dashboard
A sponsor opens the 'how we calculate this' note for a number
side_effects: The note shows the formula, the kg-per-meal value and the emission factor used for the version
CO2e appears as an estimate range labelled as an estimate
error_handling: A total with no visible assumption version is blocked from display and an error is logged
If the assumption set cannot be loaded, the dashboard shows raw delivered kg only with a notice that assumptions are unavailable

business_rules.name: dashboard_copy_contains_no_banned_claims
business_rules.description: All dashboard text, labels and generated summaries must avoid food-safety claims and tax, legal or liability benefit claims.
triggers: Dashboard copy or a generated quarterly summary is rendered
The output scanner runs on dashboard text before a build is deployed
side_effects: Any text containing a banned phrase is replaced by the plain template wording
The product owner is alerted when a banned phrase is detected
error_handling: A banned phrase found in generated summary text causes that text to be discarded and the template used instead
A banned phrase found in static copy fails the build

steps.description: Sponsor opens the impact view and checks each rescue's meals, kg and CO2e against its assumption version.

business_rules.name: impact_uses_delivered_quantity_only
business_rules.description: Each rescue's meals and kg come from the quantity actually delivered, never the posted quantity, using meals = delivered kg ÷ kg per meal from the assumption set.
triggers: Sponsor opens the impact view
A rescue's delivery is recorded and its impact figures are computed
side_effects: ImpactRecord.meals is computed from ImpactRecord.delivered_kg and AssumptionSet.kg_per_meal
The impact view shows the computed meals beside the delivered kg for each rescue
error_handling: If the delivered quantity is missing, the rescue is shown without meals and with a note that no delivery is recorded
If the listing's delivered quantity differs from the posted quantity, the delivered figure is shown and the difference is not counted as impact

business_rules.name: expired_and_cancelled_listings_excluded_from_impact
business_rules.description: ImpactRecords are counted only for listings that reached Delivered; listings that ended as Expired or Cancelled contribute zero to meals, kg and CO2e.
triggers: Sponsor opens the impact view
A listing moves to Expired or Cancelled
side_effects: Expired or cancelled rescues appear in the impact view with zero impact and their status shown
Totals per zone and per week exclude these rescues
error_handling: If an ImpactRecord exists for a listing whose status is Expired or Cancelled, the record is excluded from totals and the inconsistency is logged for the product owner

business_rules.name: every_impact_number_stamped_with_assumption_version
business_rules.description: Each ImpactRecord stores the AssumptionSet version it was calculated with, and every shown number displays that version beside it with a 'how we calculate this' note.
triggers: An ImpactRecord is created when a delivery is recorded
Sponsor opens a rescue's impact detail
side_effects: ImpactRecord.assumption_version is set to the current AssumptionSet.version at calculation time
The impact view displays the stored version and the formula used for each number
error_handling: If an ImpactRecord has no assumption version, its numbers are not shown and the record is flagged for recalculation

business_rules.name: assumption_set_edits_create_new_version
business_rules.description: Editing kg per meal, emission factor or rule-table reference creates a new AssumptionSet version; existing ImpactRecords keep the version they were calculated with.
triggers: Admin changes an assumption value
Admin saves a new rule-table reference
side_effects: A new AssumptionSet row with an incremented version is stored
Past ImpactRecords keep their original assumption_version; the impact view shows which version each rescue used
error_handling: If an edit leaves a required value empty, the new version is not saved and the admin is told which value is missing

business_rules.name: co2e_shown_as_range_only_when_factor_is_cited
business_rules.description: CO2e avoided is calculated as delivered kg × emission factor and is shown as an estimate range, and only once the emission factor in the active AssumptionSet is marked as cited; otherwise CO2e is hidden and only kg and meals are shown.
triggers: Sponsor opens the impact view
Impact figures are computed for a delivered rescue
side_effects: ImpactRecord.co2e_kg is stored as a low and high estimate when the factor is cited
The impact view shows CO2e as a range labelled estimate, or omits it when the factor is not cited
error_handling: If no emission factor is set, CO2e is omitted and only delivered kg and meals are shown

business_rules.name: impact_falls_back_to_raw_kg_when_assumptions_unavailable
business_rules.description: When the active AssumptionSet lacks kg per meal or emission factor, the impact view shows only delivered kg for affected rescues rather than an unsupported derived number.
triggers: Sponsor opens the impact view
The active AssumptionSet is incomplete
side_effects: Meals and CO2e are hidden for the affected rescues and delivered kg is shown with a note explaining the missing assumption
error_handling: If the AssumptionSet cannot be loaded, the view shows delivered kg only and logs the failure

business_rules.name: impact_wording_excludes_banned_claims
business_rules.description: Impact text and labels must not state tax, legal or liability benefits, and the impact view must not describe the food as safe or certified; any generated wording that breaks this is replaced by the plain template.
triggers: Impact view text is rendered
Impact report wording is generated
side_effects: Impact text that fails the blocklist check is discarded and the plain template is shown
The breach is logged and the product owner is alerted
error_handling: If the blocklist scanner flags impact text, the template is shown instead and the case is logged for the admin

business_rules.name: sponsor_sees_breakdown_per_rescue
business_rules.description: The impact view lists each delivered rescue with its meals, kg, CO2e and assumption version, so totals can be traced back to individual rescues.
triggers: Sponsor opens the impact view
Sponsor selects a zone or week total
side_effects: Each rescue row shows its own figures and version; zone and week totals equal the sum of their rows
error_handling: If a row cannot be loaded, the total is marked incomplete rather than shown without that rescue

name: Caterer Signs Up, Verifies FSSAI and Is Blocked Until Verified
description: A caterer creates a donor account, enters an FSSAI number, is verified by the admin, sees the badge, and an unverified or expired donor is blocked from posting.

steps.description: Caterer manager creates a donor account.

business_rules.name: donor_account_starts_unverified_and_blocked_from_posting
business_rules.description: A new caterer donor account is created as unverified (unverified → verified) and cannot post any listing until its FSSAI number has been verified.
triggers: Caterer manager submits the signup form
Caterer manager attempts to post a listing while the donor is unverified
side_effects: Donor.verification_status is set to unverified on creation
User is linked to the new Donor with the donor role
The caterer manager sees a message that posting is blocked until FSSAI verification completes
error_handling: Posting attempt while unverified is refused with the reason 'FSSAI verification pending'
No Listing record is created and no AI intake is called

business_rules.name: fssai_number_checked_against_registry_at_signup
business_rules.description: The submitted FSSAI licence or registration number is checked against the registry (mocked with synthetic numbers in the demo) and the donor becomes verified (unverified → verified) only when the number is valid, active and not expired.
triggers: Caterer manager submits the signup form with an FSSAI number
side_effects: Donor.verification_status becomes verified when the check passes
Donor.verification_status becomes rejected when the number is unknown, expired or mismatched
The caterer manager is told the verification result on the signup screen
error_handling: Unknown number: Donor.verification_status becomes rejected and the message says the number was not found
Expired number: Donor.verification_status becomes rejected and the message says the licence has expired
Registry check unavailable: Donor stays unverified and the manager is told to retry later

business_rules.name: licence_name_must_match_donor_account
business_rules.description: The donor name entered at signup must match the name on the FSSAI licence or registration before the donor can be verified.
triggers: Caterer manager submits the signup form with an FSSAI number
side_effects: Donor.verification_status stays unverified when the names do not match
The caterer manager is asked to correct the name or licence number
error_handling: Name mismatch: Donor.verification_status stays unverified and the reason 'name does not match licence' is shown
Name matches but the licence was already attached to another donor: the signup is blocked and the manager is told the licence is in use

business_rules.name: one_fssai_number_per_donor_account
business_rules.description: Each FSSAI number can be attached to only one donor account, so a licence cannot be shared or borrowed across accounts.
triggers: Caterer manager submits a signup with an FSSAI number already on another Donor record
side_effects: No new Donor record is created for the duplicate number
The caterer manager is told the number is already registered
error_handling: Duplicate number is refused with a message to contact the platform admin
The attempt is logged with time and submitted email for admin review

business_rules.name: donor_zone_must_be_launch_zone
business_rules.description: A donor can only be created with one of the 8 Bhubaneswar launch zones (Patia, Chandrasekharpur, Saheed Nagar, Nayapalli, Jaydev Vihar, Khandagiri, Old Town, Rasulgarh).
triggers: Caterer manager selects or enters a zone at signup
side_effects: Donor record is created only when the zone is one of the 8 launch zones
Zone is stored as a zone ID, not an address
error_handling: Zone outside the 8 launch zones: signup is blocked with a clear message that the service is not yet available there (E16)
No Donor or User record is created

business_rules.name: donor_type_limited_to_mvp_caterer_types
business_rules.description: In the MVP a donor type is limited to event caterer or wedding caterer, with hostel messes and restaurants excluded until their own rule profiles exist.
triggers: Caterer manager selects a donor type at signup
side_effects: Donor.type is saved as the selected launch type
error_handling: Any type outside event caterer or wedding caterer is refused as not yet supported

validation_rules.description: Donor business name is required and must match the name printed on the FSSAI licence.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter the business name exactly as it appears on your FSSAI licence.

validation_rules.description: FSSAI licence or registration number must be 14 digits; the demo accepts only synthetic numbers.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter a 14-digit FSSAI licence or registration number.

validation_rules.description: Zone must be one of the 8 launch zones: Patia, Chandrasekharpur, Saheed Nagar, Nayapalli, Jaydev Vihar, Khandagiri, Old Town or Rasulgarh.
validation_rules.error_message: Choose one of the 8 Bhubaneswar launch zones. Annadaan is not yet available in your area.

validation_rules.description: Donor type is required and must be event caterer or wedding caterer.
validation_rules.error_message: Choose event caterer or wedding caterer.

validation_rules.description: Contact phone must be a 10-digit mobile number; it is stored masked and used only for in-app notices.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter a valid 10-digit mobile number.

validation_rules.description: Email must be a well-formed address and unique across User records.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter a valid email address that is not already registered.

validation_rules.description: Password is required at signup and is stored only as a hash on the User record.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter a password to create your account.

steps.description: Caterer enters the FSSAI licence number on the profile.

business_rules.name: donor_must_have_verified_fssai_number_to_post
business_rules.description: A caterer donor moves through unverified → verified (or mismatched or expired) after entering an FSSAI licence or registration number, and only a verified donor may post food.
triggers: Caterer enters an FSSAI licence or registration number on the profile
Caterer attempts to post a listing while the donor's FSSAI status is not verified
side_effects: Donor.fssai_verification_status becomes verified when the mocked check accepts the number
Donor.fssai_verification_status becomes mismatched or unverified when the check rejects the number, and the caterer is told why
Posting is blocked for any donor whose Donor.fssai_verification_status is not verified, and the caterer sees the reason
error_handling: Number fails the mocked check: status stays unverified and the caterer is shown a clear reason
Number already belongs to another donor account: status stays unverified and the entry is refused
Donor attempts to post while unverified: posting is blocked before any AI call or listing creation

business_rules.name: fssai_licence_must_match_donor_account_details
business_rules.description: The business name on the FSSAI licence must match the donor account name, otherwise the donor is marked mismatched and cannot post.
triggers: Verification check returns the licence holder's business name for the entered number
side_effects: Donor.fssai_business_name is stored from the check result
Donor.fssai_verification_status becomes mismatched when the licence name does not match Donor.name
Donor.fssai_verification_status becomes verified only when the name matches
error_handling: Licence name differs from account name: status becomes mismatched and the caterer is asked to correct the account name or licence number
