Check returns no business name: status stays unverified

business_rules.name: fssai_number_belongs_to_one_donor_account
business_rules.description: An FSSAI number can be linked to only one donor account at a time, so a borrowed licence cannot be used by a second account.
triggers: Caterer enters an FSSAI number that is already stored on another donor account
side_effects: The second entry is refused and Donor.fssai_number is not saved on that account
Donor.fssai_verification_status stays unverified on the second account
error_handling: Duplicate number on another account: refused with a message to contact support rather than revealing the other account's details

business_rules.name: fssai_expiry_pauses_posting
business_rules.description: A donor's FSSAI status moves from verified to expired when the licence expiry date passes, which pauses posting the same day, and a reminder is sent 30 days before expiry.
triggers: Current date reaches 30 days before Donor.fssai_expiry_date
Current date passes Donor.fssai_expiry_date
side_effects: Caterer is reminded 30 days before expiry
Donor.fssai_verification_status becomes expired on the expiry date and posting is paused
error_handling: No expiry date returned by the check: status stays unverified and the caterer is asked to re-enter the licence

business_rules.name: fssai_verified_badge_only_when_verified
business_rules.description: The 'FSSAI-verified donor' badge appears on the donor profile only while the donor's status is verified, and no copy claims that food is safe or certified.
triggers: Donor.fssai_verification_status changes
Donor profile is viewed
side_effects: Profile shows the 'FSSAI-verified donor' badge when verified and hides it otherwise
error_handling: Status is not verified: badge is hidden and the profile shows the pending verification message

validation_rules.description: The FSSAI licence or registration number is required before the donor can be verified and post food.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter your FSSAI licence or registration number to start posting.

validation_rules.description: The FSSAI number is exactly 14 digits with no letters or symbols (spaces and hyphens are removed before checking).
validation_rules.error_message: The FSSAI number must be 14 digits. Check the number on your licence.

validation_rules.description: The FSSAI number must not already be linked to another donor account.
validation_rules.error_message: This FSSAI number is already registered to another account. Contact support if you believe this is an error.

steps.description: Admin runs the mocked FSSAI check and watches the expiry date.

business_rules.name: donor_fssai_status_must_be_verified_before_posting
business_rules.description: A donor's FSSAI status moves unverified → verified (mocked check passed) or unverified → rejected (unknown, mismatched or expired number), and only a verified donor may post listings.
triggers: Admin runs the mocked FSSAI check for a donor
Donor attempts to post a listing
side_effects: Donor.fssai_status becomes verified or rejected
Donor.fssai_verified_at is set when the check passes
a rejected donor sees the reason on their account and cannot post
the check result, with its inputs and outcome, is logged
error_handling: Number not found or mocked check fails: Donor.fssai_status becomes rejected and the donor is told the number could not be verified
Number already expired at check time: status becomes rejected with reason 'licence expired'
Licence name or address does not match the donor account: status becomes rejected with reason 'details do not match account'
Posting attempted while unverified: posting is blocked with a clear reason and nothing is sent to intake or matching

business_rules.name: donor_fssai_expiry_pauses_posting_same_day
business_rules.description: When a verified donor's Donor.fssai_expiry_date passes, Donor.fssai_status moves verified → expired and posting is paused the same day.
triggers: Current date reaches or passes Donor.fssai_expiry_date
Admin views the donor's expiry date after a check
side_effects: Donor.fssai_status becomes expired
the donor's posting access is paused
the donor is told posting is paused until the licence is renewed and re-verified
error_handling: Expiry date missing at verification: verification is refused and the admin is asked to enter it
Donor tries to post on the expiry day after the date has passed: posting is blocked with the reason 'licence expired'

business_rules.name: donor_fssai_expiry_reminder_30_days_before
business_rules.description: A donor is reminded 30 days before Donor.fssai_expiry_date so they can renew before posting is paused.
triggers: Daily check finds a verified donor whose Donor.fssai_expiry_date is 30 days away
side_effects: the donor is shown an in-app reminder to renew their FSSAI licence
the reminder is logged with the date sent
error_handling: Expiry date already within 30 days when the donor is verified: reminder is shown immediately at first login
Donor has no expiry date recorded: no reminder is sent and the admin is flagged to add it

business_rules.name: fssai_verified_badge_only_while_licence_valid
business_rules.description: The 'FSSAI-verified donor' badge is shown on Donor profiles only while Donor.fssai_status is verified, and never with wording that says food is safe or certified.
triggers: Donor profile is rendered
Donor.fssai_status changes to verified, expired or rejected
side_effects: the badge appears on the donor profile when verified
the badge is removed when the status becomes expired or rejected
error_handling: Status is verified but expiry has passed: badge is hidden until status is updated

validation_rules.description: An FSSAI licence or registration number must be entered before the mocked check can run.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter the donor's FSSAI licence or registration number to run the check.

validation_rules.description: The FSSAI number is 14 digits, using synthetic numbers in the demo.
validation_rules.error_message: The FSSAI number must be 14 digits.

validation_rules.description: The licence expiry date must be recorded before a donor can be marked verified.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter the licence expiry date before verifying this donor.

validation_rules.description: The licence expiry date must be later than today for the donor to be verified.
validation_rules.error_message: This licence has already expired. Verification is refused until a valid licence is provided.

validation_rules.description: The licence holder name must be entered so it can be matched to the donor account name.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter the business name shown on the FSSAI licence.

steps.description: Verified donor's profile shows the 'FSSAI-verified donor' badge.

business_rules.name: fssai_badge_shown_only_for_verified_donor
business_rules.description: The 'FSSAI-verified donor' badge appears on a donor's profile only when the donor's FSSAI licence or registration number has passed verification (unverified → verified).
triggers: Donor or any role opens the donor's profile page
FSSAI verification result is recorded for the donor
side_effects: Profile page renders the 'FSSAI-verified donor' badge next to the donor's name
Profile page shows no badge and offers the donor a prompt to submit or correct the licence number when Donor.fssai_verified is false
error_handling: Verification check (mocked in the demo) fails or returns no result: Donor.fssai_verified stays false, no badge is shown, and the donor sees a plain 'verification pending' message
Licence number mismatches the donor's registered name or address: badge is not shown and the donor is told the details do not match
Licence number is expired or unrecognised: badge is not shown and the donor is told why

business_rules.name: fssai_badge_wording_fixed_and_non_safety_claim
business_rules.description: The badge label is the fixed text 'FSSAI-verified donor', which verifies the business and never states that food is safe, certified or guaranteed.
triggers: Profile page renders a donor who has Donor.fssai_verified set to true
Copy or content on the profile is changed
side_effects: Profile shows only the fixed badge label beside the donor name, with no food-quality wording added
Any text on the profile that describes food as safe or certified is blocked by the copy check before release
error_handling: Copy scanner finds words such as 'safe food', 'certified food' or 'guaranteed' on the profile: the change is rejected and the build fails
Badge label is edited by a non-approved source: the fixed label is restored from the constant

business_rules.name: fssai_badge_removed_when_licence_expires
business_rules.description: The badge stops showing on the profile once the donor's FSSAI licence has expired (verified → expired, badge removed).
triggers: Licence expiry date passes
Daily licence expiry check runs
side_effects: Donor.fssai_verified is set to false when Donor.fssai_expires_at is past
Profile no longer shows the badge and shows the donor a message that the licence must be renewed
Donor is reminded 30 days before expiry (reminder handled by the expiry rule)
error_handling: Expiry date missing on a verified donor: badge is withheld until the expiry date is recorded
Expiry check cannot run: profile falls back to hiding the badge rather than showing a possibly stale verified status

steps.description: An unverified or expired donor tries to post and is blocked with a clear reason; nothing is parsed or offered.

business_rules.name: donor_must_have_verified_fssai_to_post
business_rules.description: A donor can create a listing only when Donor.fssai_status is verified (unverified → verified; any other state blocks posting).
triggers: Donor opens the post page and submits a listing
Donor starts a post from the posting screen
side_effects: No Listing record is created for the attempt
The donor sees a clear blocking message on the post page explaining that FSSAI verification is required
Donor.fssai_status is left unchanged
error_handling: Donor.fssai_status is unverified: block posting and show the reason 'Your FSSAI licence or registration is not verified yet'
Donor.fssai_number is missing: block posting and ask the donor to add their FSSAI number
Verification check is unavailable (mocked check fails to respond): block posting and tell the donor verification is pending; do not create a Listing

business_rules.name: expired_fssai_pauses_posting_same_day
business_rules.description: When today's date passes Donor.fssai_expiry_date, Donor.fssai_status becomes expired (verified → expired) and posting is blocked immediately.
triggers: Donor.fssai_expiry_date is reached or passed
Donor submits a listing after the licence expiry date
side_effects: Donor.fssai_status becomes expired
The donor is told that posting is paused because the FSSAI licence has expired and must be renewed
Any listing already in Posted state for this donor is not changed by this rule
error_handling: Donor.fssai_expiry_date passed at submission time: block posting with the reason 'Your FSSAI licence expired on [date]; renew it to post again'
Expiry date is missing on a verified donor: treat as expired and block posting

business_rules.name: mismatched_fssai_details_block_posting
business_rules.description: A donor posts only when the FSSAI licence number and the registered name on it match the donor account; a mismatch sets Donor.fssai_status to mismatched and blocks posting.
triggers: Donor submits a listing with an FSSAI number that does not match the account's registered name
Verification check returns a different name for the entered FSSAI number
side_effects: Donor.fssai_status becomes mismatched
The donor is shown the mismatch reason and told to correct their details
No Listing record is created
error_handling: Licence name differs from Donor.registered_name: block posting with 'The FSSAI number does not match your business name'
Number not found by the mocked check: set status to unverified and block posting

business_rules.name: blocked_post_is_never_parsed_or_offered
business_rules.description: When a donor is blocked, the submitted text or voice input is discarded without parsing, no AI call is made, and no matching or offer runs.
triggers: A blocked donor submits free text or a voice note on the post page
Donor verification fails at the start of posting
side_effects: The submitted input is not sent to the anthropic intake service and nothing is extracted
No Offer is created and no receiver or volunteer is notified
The attempt is written to the audit log with the donor, time and block reason
error_handling: Verification fails after input is typed: discard the input text, keep the blocking message, and do not call intake
Attempt logging fails: still block posting and retry the log entry

business_rules.name: block_reason_is_clear_and_shown_on_donor_profile
business_rules.description: Every block records one plain-language reason on the donor, and the same reason is shown on the post page and on the donor profile.
triggers: Any verification check fails during posting
Donor opens the post page while blocked
side_effects: The post page displays the current block reason and next step
The donor profile shows the status and the date of the last check
error_handling: Status is unknown: show 'Verification status unavailable, try again later' and block posting
Reason text contains banned words such as 'safe' or 'certified': replace with the fixed template reason

name: Admin Onboards Receivers and Volunteers
description: The platform admin adds receivers and volunteers, gives roles, verifies receiver FSSAI registration and the receiver checks their own status.

steps.description: Platform admin signs in with the admin role.

business_rules.name: admin_role_required_for_admin_access
business_rules.description: Only a User whose role is admin can open the platform admin area, where receivers are onboarded, flagged listings are reviewed and assumption values are maintained.
triggers: A user submits the sign-in form on the login page
A user tries to open an admin-only screen directly
side_effects: A signed-in session is created that carries the User.role value
Users without the admin role are redirected away from admin screens to their own role's view
error_handling: A user whose role is not admin is denied admin access and shown a plain message that the account lacks admin rights
A sign-in with no role selected is rejected and the user is asked to choose a role
A session with no valid role is treated as signed out and sent back to the login page

business_rules.name: mvp_sign_in_uses_demo_role_selection
business_rules.description: In the MVP, sign-in selects one of the demo roles, including admin, without real credentials; real sign-in is deferred to the hardening phase.
triggers: A user chooses a role on the login page and continues
side_effects: The chosen demo User becomes the active user for the session
The role-switcher choice is available for the whole demo
error_handling: If the chosen demo User record does not exist in the seed data, sign-in is refused and the seed-reset step is suggested
If the platform is asked for real credentials in the MVP, the request is refused as out of scope

business_rules.name: admin_user_is_product_owner_in_mvp
business_rules.description: In the MVP the single admin User is the product owner, who fills the platform admin role for every admin action.
triggers: The seed script creates the admin User
An admin action is performed during the MVP
side_effects: The admin User record is created with a synthetic name and the admin role
Admin actions are logged against this User
error_handling: If no admin User exists after seeding, the admin sign-in option is hidden and the seed-reset step is flagged

business_rules.name: admin_sign_in_uses_synthetic_identity_only
business_rules.description: The admin User carries only a generated synthetic name and no real personal details, in line with the synthetic-data-only rule.
triggers: The admin User is seeded for the demo or tests
side_effects: The login page shows the synthetic name for the chosen admin role
error_handling: If a real-looking name or contact is entered in seed data, the seed is rejected

validation_rules.description: A role must be chosen from the demo roles before sign-in proceeds.
validation_rules.error_message: Choose a role to continue.

validation_rules.description: The chosen role must be one of the known roles (donor, receiver, volunteer, sponsor, admin).
validation_rules.error_message: That role is not available. Choose a role from the list.

steps.description: Admin adds receivers and volunteers, assigns roles and can deactivate accounts.

business_rules.name: receiver_must_be_fssai_registered_to_be_matched
business_rules.description: A receiver becomes eligible for matching only after its FSSAI registration is verified (unverified → verified → matchable), and an unregistered receiver never appears in matching.
triggers: Admin adds a new receiver with an FSSAI registration number
Admin updates a receiver's FSSAI registration number
Admin marks a receiver's registration as verified
side_effects: Receiver.is_verified is set to true only when the mocked registration check passes
Receiver stays out of the matching pool while Receiver.is_verified is false
Admin sees the receiver listed as pending verification
error_handling: Registration number missing or malformed: receiver is saved as unverified and cannot be matched
Registration number fails the mocked check: receiver is saved as unverified and admin is told the reason
Registration number already used by another receiver: save is blocked and admin is told the number is duplicated

business_rules.name: deactivated_account_is_excluded_from_matching_and_open_work
business_rules.description: Deactivating a user (active → deactivated) removes that receiver or volunteer from matching and releases any open offers or claims they hold.
triggers: Admin deactivates a receiver account
Admin deactivates a volunteer account
side_effects: The deactivated account is removed from the matching pool immediately
Open offers to a deactivated receiver are withdrawn and the next match is offered
A listing claimed by a deactivated volunteer or receiver returns to Posted, or expires if its deadline is too close
The affected donor is told when a listing is released
error_handling: Deactivation attempted on an account with a collected but undelivered listing: deactivation is allowed, and the listing is escalated for reassignment
Reactivation requested: account returns to matching only after its verification and zone checks pass again

business_rules.name: role_assignment_limited_to_receiver_or_volunteer_in_mvp
business_rules.description: An admin assigns each user exactly one role from receiver or volunteer, and the platform admin role is reserved for the product owner in the MVP.
triggers: Admin creates a new user account
Admin changes an existing user's role
side_effects: User.role is set to receiver or volunteer, which determines which records and views the account can reach
A role change is logged with the time and the acting admin
error_handling: A user without an assigned role cannot be saved: admin is told to choose a role
Admin attempts to assign the platform admin role: change is blocked and admin is told it is reserved in the MVP

business_rules.name: receiver_and_volunteer_located_in_launch_zone
business_rules.description: Every receiver and volunteer is assigned to one of the eight launch zones (Patia, Chandrasekharpur, Saheed Nagar, Nayapalli, Jaydev Vihar, Khandagiri, Old Town, Rasulgarh) and only by zone ID, never by exact address.
triggers: Admin saves a new receiver with a zone
Admin saves a new volunteer with a zone
Admin changes a receiver's or volunteer's zone
side_effects: The account is placed in that zone's matching and volunteer pool
Receiver or volunteer appears in zone-level views for that zone only
error_handling: Zone outside the eight launch zones: save is blocked and admin is told that only launch zones are supported
Zone left empty: save is blocked and admin is told to choose a zone

business_rules.name: receiver_capacity_and_need_set_by_admin_and_drive_matching
business_rules.description: Each receiver's daily capacity, need level and dietary restrictions are recorded at onboarding and used as matching inputs, and the receiver's reliability score is system-maintained rather than set by admin.
triggers: Admin saves a receiver's daily capacity, need level or dietary restrictions
Admin edits a receiver's profile
side_effects: Matching uses these values for the hard filters (capacity, dietary conflict) and the score (need, quantity fit)
Receiver.reliability is left unchanged by this page and changes only through recorded no-shows
error_handling: Dietary restriction conflicting with another recorded restriction: admin is told to correct the entry
Daily capacity left empty: save is blocked

business_rules.name: onboarding_data_must_be_synthetic_and_masked
business_rules.description: Names and contacts entered for receivers and volunteers must be synthetic, and phone numbers are stored masked so that no real personal details are kept.
triggers: Admin enters a receiver's or volunteer's name and phone number
Admin saves a receiver or volunteer profile
side_effects: User.phone is stored in masked form and only its masked version is shown in lists
Profile is saved as synthetic data for demo and tests
error_handling: Phone number entered in an unmasked real-world format that fails the synthetic pattern: save is blocked and admin is told to use the synthetic format
Name matches a known real-person pattern flagged by admin review: save is held for review

business_rules.name: admin_changes_are_logged_with_actor_and_time
business_rules.description: Every account creation, role change, verification change and deactivation is logged with the time and the admin who made it.
triggers: Admin creates, edits, verifies, or deactivates a user account
side_effects: An audit entry is recorded with the changed field, old and new values, time and acting admin
Audit entries are visible to the platform admin for review
error_handling: Audit entry cannot be written: the account change is rolled back so that no unlogged change persists
Account change without an identifiable admin actor: change is blocked

validation_rules.error_message: Name must be between 2 and 80 characters.
