steps.description: Admin verifies each receiver's FSSAI registration so only registered organisations appear in matching.

business_rules.name: only_verified_receivers_enter_matching
business_rules.description: A receiver's FSSAI status moves through pending → verified or rejected, and only a verified receiver is eligible for matching.
triggers: Admin opens a receiver's FSSAI registration for review on the verification page
Admin approves or rejects the receiver's FSSAI registration
side_effects: Receiver.fssai_status becomes verified on approval, so the receiver becomes eligible for matching
Receiver.fssai_status becomes rejected on rejection, and the receiver is excluded from matching
Receiver.fssai_verified_at and Receiver.fssai_verified_by are set to the time and the admin User on approval
The receiver is notified of the outcome through the in-app notification
error_handling: Receiver with fssai_status pending or rejected never appears in matching results
If the admin attempts to approve a receiver with no fssai_number, the approval is refused and the admin is told the number is missing
If the verification check cannot run, the receiver stays pending and is not offered any listings

business_rules.name: fssai_verification_uses_mocked_check_in_demo
business_rules.description: In the demo, the FSSAI registration check is mocked against synthetic registration numbers, and a live portal lookup is deferred to hardening.
triggers: Admin runs the FSSAI check for a receiver's registration number
side_effects: The check result is recorded on Receiver.fssai_status, and the result is labelled as mocked in the demo
error_handling: A mocked check that returns no result leaves Receiver.fssai_status as pending
Live portal lookup is not called during the demo; the check result is never presented as a live government confirmation

business_rules.name: fssai_registration_must_be_current
business_rules.description: A receiver can be verified only if its FSSAI registration has an expiry date that is still in the future, and an expired registration pauses access.
triggers: Admin approves a receiver's FSSAI registration
Receiver's registration expiry date passes while the receiver is verified
side_effects: Approval is blocked if Receiver.fssai_expiry_date is missing or not in the future
On expiry, Receiver.fssai_status moves from verified to expired and Receiver.is_active is set to false, removing the receiver from matching the same day
The admin is told which receiver's registration has expired
error_handling: Expiry date in the past blocks approval with a clear reason
A verified receiver whose registration expires is removed from matching without waiting for the next verification run

business_rules.name: rejection_requires_a_reason
business_rules.description: When an admin rejects a receiver's FSSAI registration, a rejection reason is recorded and the receiver is told what to correct.
triggers: Admin selects reject for a receiver's FSSAI registration
side_effects: Receiver.fssai_status becomes rejected and Receiver.fssai_rejection_reason stores the admin's reason
The receiver is notified of the rejection and the reason in the in-app notification
error_handling: Rejection without a reason is refused and the admin is asked to give one
A rejected receiver can be resubmitted for verification after correction

validation_rules.description: An FSSAI registration number must be entered before a receiver can be verified.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter the receiver's FSSAI registration number before verifying.

validation_rules.description: The FSSAI registration number is 14 digits with no letters or spaces.
validation_rules.error_message: FSSAI number must be 14 digits.

validation_rules.description: The registration expiry date must be provided and must be later than today.
validation_rules.error_message: Expiry date must be a future date. Check the registration document.

validation_rules.description: The admin must choose either approve or reject before the verification is saved.
validation_rules.error_message: Choose approve or reject before saving.

validation_rules.description: A rejection reason is required when the decision is reject, and it must be between 10 and 300 characters.
validation_rules.error_message: Give a reason of 10 to 300 characters so the receiver knows what to correct.

steps.description: Receiver checks their own details and FSSAI status on the profile, then signs out.

business_rules.name: receiver_sees_own_fssai_status_on_profile
business_rules.description: A receiver can view their own profile details and FSSAI registration status (verified, pending, expired or paused) without being able to change them.
triggers: Receiver opens their profile page
Receiver checks their FSSAI status before accepting offers
side_effects: Profile shows the receiver's FSSAI number, status and expiry date
No Receiver record is changed by viewing the profile
error_handling: If the receiver's FSSAI status cannot be loaded, the profile shows 'status unavailable, try again' and the receiver is not shown a status they do not have
If the receiver has no FSSAI number on file, the status shows 'not registered' and the receiver is told to contact the admin

business_rules.name: receiver_cannot_self_edit_fssai_registration
business_rules.description: Receivers cannot change their own FSSAI number, status or expiry date; these are set only by the platform admin after verification.
triggers: Receiver tries to edit FSSAI fields on the profile
Receiver submits a changed FSSAI number
side_effects: Edit attempt is rejected and logged with time and actor
Receiver.fssai_status stays unchanged
error_handling: Edit attempt returns a message that registration changes are made by the platform admin
No partial update of the FSSAI fields is saved

business_rules.name: expired_fssai_status_is_shown_as_paused
business_rules.description: When a receiver's FSSAI registration has expired, the profile shows the status as paused and states the reason, and the receiver is excluded from matching until it is renewed and verified.
triggers: Receiver.fssai_expires_at passes
Receiver opens the profile after expiry
side_effects: Receiver.fssai_status becomes paused
Receiver is not offered new listings
Profile shows 'paused: FSSAI registration expired' with the expiry date
error_handling: If the expiry date is missing, status is set to pending and the admin is alerted rather than treating the receiver as verified
Receiver who is already holding a claimed listing keeps it until handover, and the admin is told

business_rules.name: receiver_profile_shows_zone_not_address
business_rules.description: The receiver profile shows the receiver's zone ID and synthetic name only, never a full street address or unmasked contact details.
triggers: Receiver opens the profile page
side_effects: Profile displays zone name and synthetic receiver name
No address or unmasked phone number is rendered
error_handling: If a stored address field is found on the record, it is not rendered and the issue is logged for the admin

business_rules.name: receiver_sign_out_ends_session_only
business_rules.description: Signing out ends the receiver's session and returns them to the sign-in screen, while their receiver record, open claims and offers stay as they are.
triggers: Receiver taps sign out on the profile page
side_effects: User session is ended and User.signed_out_at is recorded
Receiver is returned to the role switcher or sign-in screen
Sign-out event is logged with time and actor
error_handling: If the session is already ended, sign out returns the receiver to the sign-in screen without an error
If sign-out fails on the server, the local session is still cleared and the failure is logged

business_rules.name: sign_out_does_not_cancel_claims_or_deadlines
business_rules.description: Signing out does not release a claimed listing, cancel an offer or pause deadline timers; the receiver's open claims continue under server-side rules.
triggers: Receiver signs out while holding a claimed listing or an open offer
side_effects: Listing.status stays claimed
Offer timeouts keep running
Receiver is notified in-app on next sign-in if an offer has expired or been re-offered
error_handling: If the receiver does not sign in again before an offer times out, the offer moves to the next receiver as normal
Offers still open at sign-out are shown on next sign-in with their remaining time

business_rules.name: fssai_status_copy_avoids_safety_claims
business_rules.description: The FSSAI status shown on the receiver profile uses registration wording only and never says the food, the receiver's kitchen or the donation is safe or certified.
triggers: Profile page renders the FSSAI status section
side_effects: Status text reads as a registration status, for example 'FSSAI registration verified'
Copy scanner check passes on the profile page
error_handling: If any status copy contains banned wording such as 'safe' or 'certified food', the text is replaced with the plain template and the breach is logged

name: Admin Reviews Flagged Listings and Locked Handovers
description: The admin sees what needs review on the home page, opens the flag queue and decides on each flagged listing or locked handover.

steps.description: Platform admin signs in.

business_rules.name: only_platform_admin_role_reaches_admin_review
business_rules.description: Sign-in grants access to the admin review area only when the User's role is platform admin; every other role is sent to its own view.
triggers: Platform admin submits the sign-in form
A user with a non-admin role attempts to open the admin review area
side_effects: A User with role platform admin and is_active true is taken to the flagged listings and locked handovers review
A User with any other role is not shown the admin review area
error_handling: Valid credentials for a non-admin role: user is denied admin access and told the account does not have admin permission
User.is_active is false: sign-in is refused with a message that the account is inactive
Unknown email or wrong password: a generic 'email or password is incorrect' message is shown, without revealing which field was wrong

business_rules.name: demo_role_switch_selects_existing_user_role
business_rules.description: In the MVP, sign-in is a role switcher for the demo: the chosen role selects an existing synthetic User and no real credentials are verified until the hardening phase.
triggers: Platform admin picks the admin role on the demo sign-in form
Demo reviewer switches roles on the sign-in page
side_effects: The session is bound to the existing synthetic User with role platform admin
Real sign-in and password verification are deferred to the harden-for-pilot phase
error_handling: No synthetic User exists for the chosen role: sign-in is refused and the seed-reset script is suggested to the demo operator

business_rules.name: admin_sign_in_is_logged_for_audit
business_rules.description: Each successful admin sign-in is recorded with time and actor so admin actions can be traced to a person.
triggers: Platform admin signs in successfully
side_effects: User.last_signed_in_at is set to the current time
The sign-in is written to the audit log with the User as actor
error_handling: Audit write fails: sign-in still completes, the failure is logged, and the product owner is alerted

validation_rules.description: Email is required to sign in.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter your email address to sign in.

validation_rules.description: Email must be in a valid address format (name@domain).
validation_rules.error_message: Enter a valid email address, such as name@example.com.

validation_rules.description: Password is required to sign in.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter your password to sign in.

validation_rules.description: A role must be selected on the demo role switcher.
validation_rules.error_message: Choose a role to continue.

steps.description: Home shows the admin what needs review.

business_rules.name: home_lists_items_needing_admin_review
business_rules.description: The admin home shows the flagged listings and the locked handovers that need a decision, and nothing else that requires action.
triggers: Admin opens the home page
Admin returns to the home page after reviewing an item
side_effects: No records are changed by displaying the list
Each item shows its listing or handover, the reason it was flagged, and the zone it is in
error_handling: No flagged listings and no locked handovers: home shows an empty state saying nothing needs review
A user without the admin role opening the home sees no review queue and is directed to their own role view

business_rules.name: flagged_listings_shown_by_urgency
business_rules.description: Flagged listings are ordered by their consume-by deadline, soonest first, so the most time-critical food is reviewed first.
triggers: Admin opens the home page with one or more flagged listings
side_effects: Listings past their consume-by deadline are shown as expired rather than as needing review
error_handling: Listing with a missing consume-by time: shown at the top of the queue marked as needing a deadline check

business_rules.name: locked_handover_shows_masked_identity_only
business_rules.description: Locked handovers show the volunteer by masked name and the donor's contact masked, never the exact pickup point.
triggers: Admin opens the home page with a locked handover in the queue
side_effects: Admin sees the zone, masked volunteer name and masked donor contact for the locked handover
error_handling: Contact or name missing on the record: shows a placeholder and not the raw value

business_rules.name: flags_raised_by_receivers_or_ai_appear_in_queue
business_rules.description: A flag raised by a receiver reporting a problem or by a discarded AI output is added to the review queue on the home page.
triggers: A receiver reports a problem with a listing
The system discards an AI output that contained a banned claim or injected instruction
side_effects: Listing.review_flag is set with its reason
The admin is told through the home page queue
A StatusEvent records who raised the flag and when
error_handling: A flag raised on a listing that is already expired or cancelled: recorded in the log but not added to the active queue

steps.description: Admin works the queue of flagged listings and locked handovers and decides on each.

business_rules.name: admin_only_flag_queue_access
business_rules.description: Only a User with the platform admin role can open the flag review queue and decide on flagged listings and locked handovers.
triggers: An admin opens the flag review page
A non-admin user requests the flag review queue
side_effects: The queue of flagged listings and locked handovers is shown only to admin users
Any other user is refused access and the attempt is logged
error_handling: A non-admin request to the queue is rejected with no queue data returned
An admin session that has lapsed must sign in again before a decision is saved

business_rules.name: flagged_listing_admin_decision
business_rules.description: Each flagged listing is decided by the admin as keep (returned to its prior status), cancel, or expire, and the chosen outcome is applied to Listing.status with the reason recorded.
triggers: A receiver reports a problem with a listing
A receiver flags a quantity or item mismatch at pickup
Temperature at handover is out of range (FR-20)
The output scanner blocks LLM text on a listing (E14)
The admin chooses a decision on a flagged listing in the queue
side_effects: Listing.status moves to the outcome chosen by the admin (keep restores the prior status, cancel moves to Cancelled, expire moves to Expired)
Listing.flag_reason is cleared once a decision is saved
The donor and the claiming receiver are told the outcome
error_handling: A decision on a listing already decided by another admin is rejected and the admin sees the current status
A decision with no reason text is not saved
A keep decision on a listing already past its consume-by deadline is refused and the listing is expired instead

business_rules.name: deadline_protected_on_admin_decision
business_rules.description: An admin decision can never extend Listing.consume_by or return a listing to Offered or Claimed once the consume-by deadline has passed.
triggers: The admin chooses keep on a flagged listing
The admin unlocks a locked handover on a listing
side_effects: A listing past its deadline moves to Expired and the donor and receivers are told
Listing.consume_by stays as set by the rule table
error_handling: A keep or unlock attempt past the deadline is refused with the reason 'past consume-by deadline'
If the deadline falls within 30 minutes, the listing is marked unrescuable rather than offered

business_rules.name: locked_handover_admin_review
business_rules.description: After three wrong handover codes, the Offer is locked (wrong code 3 times → handover locked) and the admin reviews it, deciding to unlock the code entry or to cancel and reassign the handover.
triggers: Three wrong handover codes are entered for the same Offer
The admin opens a locked handover in the queue
side_effects: Offer.handover_locked is set to true on the third wrong code
On unlock, Offer.handover_failed_attempts resets to 0 and the volunteer may enter the code again
On cancel and reassign, Offer.volunteer_id is replaced and the listing returns to Claimed for a new volunteer
The donor is shown the volunteer's masked name to confirm in person; the donor, volunteer and admin are told of the lock
error_handling: A code entered against a locked Offer is refused and no status change occurs
If no replacement volunteer is available before the deadline, the listing expires and all parties are told

business_rules.name: admin_decision_logged_with_actor
business_rules.description: Every admin decision writes a StatusEvent with the admin as actor, the from and to status, a timestamp and a reason.
triggers: The admin saves a decision on a flagged listing
The admin unlocks, cancels or reassigns a locked handover
side_effects: A new StatusEvent row is appended to the listing's history
The decision appears in the live status view for all parties
error_handling: If the StatusEvent cannot be written, the decision is not applied and the admin sees a save error

business_rules.name: receiver_reliability_adjusted_by_flags
business_rules.description: A receiver whose flagged problem is upheld by the admin, or who repeatedly no-shows, has Receiver.reliability_score reduced, with the weight capped so matching stays fair.
triggers: The admin upholds a receiver's report of a problem
The admin records a no-show against a receiver on a flagged listing
side_effects: Receiver.reliability_score is lowered by the configured step
Future matching uses the updated score within the 5% reliability weight cap
error_handling: A reliability change that would drop the score below zero is clamped to zero
A reliability change on a receiver not registered as FSSAI-registered is not applied and the admin is told

business_rules.name: volunteer_suspended_on_locked_handover
business_rules.description: A volunteer whose handover was locked is stood down from the Offer until the admin decides, and is not re-offered that listing.
triggers: The admin cancels and reassigns a locked handover
side_effects: Volunteer.status is set to stood down for this listing
The volunteer is not offered the same listing again
error_handling: If the volunteer is the only one available in the zone, the admin is told and the listing expires if no replacement exists

business_rules.name: flagged_mismatch_added_to_golden_set
business_rules.description: When the admin confirms a receiver's pickup mismatch flag as valid, the listing's original text and the correct values are added to the golden dataset.
triggers: The admin marks a receiver's mismatch flag as valid
side_effects: A new golden case is created from the listing's intake text and confirmed values for the next evaluation run
error_handling: A flag without the original intake text is not added and the admin is told it could not be recorded

validation_rules.description: The admin must choose one of keep, cancel, expire, unlock or reassign before a flagged item is saved.
validation_rules.error_message: Choose a decision before saving.

validation_rules.description: The reason for an admin decision is 10 to 500 characters.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter a reason of 10 to 500 characters so the decision can be audited.

validation_rules.description: Unlocking a locked handover requires the admin to confirm that the donor has checked the volunteer's masked name in person.
validation_rules.error_message: Confirm the donor has checked the volunteer in person before unlocking.

steps.description: Admin opens the flagged listing to review its details, flags and status history.

business_rules.name: only_platform_admin_can_review_flagged_listings
business_rules.description: Only a User with the platform admin role can open a flagged Listing's review view and its flags and status history.
triggers: A user opens the ListingDetailPage for a listing that has active flags
side_effects: Non-admin users are refused the review view and see no flag details
The access attempt is recorded in the audit log with the user and time
error_handling: User without the admin role opens the flagged listing: access denied and the attempt is logged
Session has no user: user is sent to the role switcher before the review view loads

business_rules.name: status_history_is_complete_and_ordered
business_rules.description: The status history of a Listing lists every StatusEvent in order from oldest to newest, each showing the from status, to status, actor and time, through the states Posted, Offered, Claimed, Collected, Delivered, Expired and Cancelled.
triggers: Admin opens the status history section of a flagged listing
side_effects: The admin sees a timeline of how the listing moved from posting to its current status
The current Listing.status is shown as the last entry in the timeline
error_handling: A listing with no StatusEvent rows: the history shows the listing's current status with a note that no earlier events were recorded
A StatusEvent with a missing actor: shown as 'system' only if the event was automatic, otherwise flagged as an audit gap for the admin

business_rules.name: opening_review_does_not_change_listing_state
business_rules.description: Opening a flagged listing for review never changes its status, its flags or its history; only an explicit admin action can do so, and each such action is logged as a StatusEvent or flag change.
triggers: Admin opens the ListingDetailPage for a flagged listing
side_effects: No StatusEvent is created by viewing the page
The listing's deadline and expiry timers continue unchanged
error_handling: Listing is past its consume-by deadline while under review: the server expires it on schedule, and the admin sees the expiry in the history when refreshed
Page reload during review: the view reads the current state from the database and shows the same history

name: Admin Edits Assumptions and Rule Tables
description: The admin changes kg per meal, emission factor or a rule table and publishes a new versioned assumption set that later reports will cite.

steps.description: Platform admin signs in.

business_rules.name: admin_role_required_for_assumption_editing
business_rules.description: Only users with the platform admin role may open the assumption and rule table editor, where assumption values and rule tables are changed and versioned.
triggers: A user signs in and requests the assumption or rule table editor
A signed-in user attempts to edit an AssumptionSet or rule table
side_effects: A signed-in user without the admin role is denied access to the editor
Admin sign-in grants access to edit AssumptionSet values, creating a new AssumptionSet.version on save
error_handling: User without admin role opens the editor: access is refused and the user is returned to their own role's home view
Session expires while editing: unsaved changes are not written and the admin is asked to sign in again

business_rules.name: mvp_admin_account_held_by_product_owner
business_rules.description: In the MVP, the single platform admin User account is held by the product owner, and no other admin accounts are created.
triggers: Platform admin signs in during the MVP or demo
Seed script creates the demo users
side_effects: The seeded admin User record is linked to the product owner's synthetic identity
No additional admin users are created during the MVP
error_handling: Attempt to create a second admin user in the MVP: creation is refused and the request is logged

business_rules.name: demo_role_switcher_for_mvp_accounts
business_rules.description: During the MVP demo, sign-in is a role switcher that selects a seeded synthetic User account, and real credential sign-in is deferred to the hardening phase.
triggers: Presenter selects a role on the login page during the demo
Hardening phase replaces the role switcher with real sign-in
side_effects: The selected seeded User becomes the active session for the demo
Sign-in attempts are recorded against the selected User
error_handling: Selected role has no seeded User: the switcher shows no account is available and the demo seed script should be rerun

business_rules.name: admin_sign_in_is_logged
business_rules.description: Every successful admin sign-in is recorded with the time and the User, so assumption edits can be traced to an actor.
triggers: Admin completes sign-in on the login page
Admin opens the assumption editor after signing in
side_effects: User.last_signed_in_at is set to the current time
The sign-in is available to the audit trail for later assumption changes
error_handling: Audit write fails: sign-in is blocked and the admin sees a generic retry message, so no unlogged admin session starts

validation_rules.description: Admin email is required to sign in and must be a synthetic address, not a real personal address.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter your admin email address to sign in.

validation_rules.description: Admin email must be in a valid email format.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter a valid email address, for example admin@example.com.

validation_rules.description: Password is required to sign in once real sign-in replaces the demo role switcher in hardening.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter your password to sign in.

steps.description: Admin edits kg per meal, emission factor and rule tables, then publishes a new versioned set.

business_rules.name: assumption_edits_publish_as_new_immutable_version
business_rules.description: Editing kg per meal, the emission factor or the rule tables never changes a published set; publishing creates a new AssumptionSet version (published set v1 → new set v2), and every earlier version is kept unchanged.
triggers: Admin clicks publish after editing kg per meal, emission factor or rule tables
Admin saves a draft of assumption values
side_effects: A new AssumptionSet record is created with the next version number and the edited values
The previously published AssumptionSet is retained and remains readable for old reports
The new version becomes the set used for new impact calculations and new listing deadlines
error_handling: If a publish fails partway, no new AssumptionSet version is created and the previously published version stays active
If two admins publish at the same time, only one new version is created and the other admin is told to reload and retry

business_rules.name: reports_and_impact_state_assumption_version
business_rules.description: Every impact calculation is stamped with the AssumptionSet version used, so a published version's numbers stay reproducible after later changes (v1 → v2 does not restate v1 results).
triggers: An ImpactRecord is created when a listing is delivered
A donor weekly report or sponsor dashboard is generated
side_effects: ImpactRecord stores the AssumptionSet version it was computed with
Meals and CO2e are computed from the kg per meal and emission factor of that version
Reports display the version number next to each figure
error_handling: If no AssumptionSet version has been published, impact calculation is blocked and the admin is told to publish one
If the emission factor is missing or uncited, the CO2e figure is hidden and only kg and meals are shown

business_rules.name: only_platform_admin_can_edit_assumptions
business_rules.description: Only a User with the platform admin role can edit or publish AssumptionSet values; donors, receivers, volunteers and sponsors cannot view-edit or publish them.
triggers: A user opens the assumptions page
A user submits an assumption edit or publish request
side_effects: Non-admin users are denied access and see no edit controls
Denied attempts are logged with the User and time
error_handling: A non-admin publish attempt is rejected with an access message and no AssumptionSet is changed

business_rules.name: consume_by_rule_table_changes_cannot_extend_deadlines_past_safe_limits
business_rules.description: A published rule table sets the most conservative consume-by limits; a rule-table edit can shorten or keep limits but the system never allows a published rule to extend a deadline beyond the table's limit for a food type and storage condition.
triggers: Admin publishes a new rule table version
A listing's consume-by deadline is computed from the active rule table
side_effects: New listings use the new rule-table version to compute consume-by
Listings already posted keep the deadline computed under their original rule-table version
error_handling: If a rule-table entry is missing for a food type, the most conservative default limit is used and the admin is warned at publish time
If a rule-table entry would extend a limit beyond the most conservative value, publish is blocked

business_rules.name: meals_and_co2e_use_only_delivered_quantity_from_active_version
business_rules.description: Meals avoided are delivered kg divided by the published kg per meal, and CO2e avoided is delivered kg multiplied by the published emission factor; posted or expired quantities are never used.
triggers: A delivery is recorded and its impact is calculated
An impact figure is refreshed for a report
side_effects: ImpactRecord.meals and ImpactRecord.co2e are set from the active version's values
The impact view shows each figure with its formula and version
error_handling: If kg per meal is missing or not positive, meals are not calculated and only delivered kg is shown

business_rules.name: emission_factor_requires_citation_before_co2e_is_shown
business_rules.description: The CO2e figure is shown to users only when the active AssumptionSet has an emission factor that has been cited; until then CO2e is withheld and the impact view shows kg and meals only.
triggers: Admin publishes a version with a new emission factor
Impact view or report is rendered
side_effects: CO2e is displayed as an estimate range once a cited factor is active
Without a cited factor, ImpactRecord.co2e is left empty and the view omits CO2e
error_handling: A factor with no source is saved as a draft only and cannot be published as the active factor

validation_rules.description: Kg per meal is a number greater than 0 and no more than 2 kg, with the starting value 0.4.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter kg per meal as a number greater than 0 and up to 2.

validation_rules.description: Emission factor is a number of kg CO2e per kg of food, zero or greater, and must be entered with a source citation before publishing.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter an emission factor of 0 or more, and add its source before publishing.

validation_rules.description: Rule table version is required on publish and must follow the pattern v<major>.<minor> (for example v1.0).
validation_rules.error_message: Enter a rule table version in the form v1.0 before publishing.

name: Admin Monitors Metrics, Live Status and Token Budget
description: The admin reviews funnel metrics, watches status changes across the platform and checks token usage against the 70% budget alert.

steps.description: Platform admin signs in.

business_rules.name: admin_role_required_for_monitoring
business_rules.description: Only a User with the platform admin role can open the metrics, live status and token budget views; any other role is refused.
triggers: A user signs in and requests the admin monitoring views
A user with a non-admin role navigates directly to the metrics, live status or token budget pages
side_effects: The admin monitoring views are shown only to the signed-in platform admin
A non-admin user is shown a no-access message and the monitoring data is not loaded
error_handling: User.role is not platform admin: access denied with a plain message and no monitoring data shown
User.is_active is false: sign-in refused and the user is told the account is inactive

business_rules.name: mvp_demo_role_switch_sign_in
business_rules.description: In the MVP, sign-in is a role switcher for the demo: the chosen User record and its role become the signed-in identity, and real credential sign-in is deferred to the hardening phase.
triggers: The platform admin selects the admin role on the login page during the demo
The platform admin submits the login form with an email
side_effects: The session is bound to the matching User record and its role for the rest of the demo
Every subsequent admin action is logged against that User as actor
error_handling: Email matches no User record: sign-in refused and the user is asked to check the email
Selected role does not match the User.role on record: sign-in refused

business_rules.name: admin_actions_attributed_to_user
business_rules.description: Once the platform admin is signed in, every action taken in the monitoring views is recorded with that User as the actor, so the audit trail shows who did what.
triggers: The signed-in platform admin performs any action in the monitoring or admin views
side_effects: The actor User.id is attached to the logged event for the action
error_handling: No signed-in User: the action is refused and the user is sent back to sign-in

validation_rules.description: Email is required to sign in and must be entered before the login form can submit.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter your email address to sign in.

validation_rules.description: Email must be in a valid address format (for example name@domain.tld).
validation_rules.error_message: Enter a valid email address, such as name@example.com.

validation_rules.description: During the demo the admin must select a role from the role switcher before signing in.
validation_rules.error_message: Choose a role to continue.

validation_rules.description: A password is required only once real sign-in replaces the demo role switcher in the hardening phase.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter your password.

steps.description: Internal metrics show funnel events and section 4 metrics computed from status events.

business_rules.name: funnel_counts_derived_from_status_events
business_rules.description: Every funnel stage (post started, posted, offered, claimed, collected, delivered, expired, cancelled) is counted from timestamped StatusEvent rows, so the internal metrics page reflects only recorded transitions.
triggers: Admin opens the internal metrics page
A listing changes status and a StatusEvent row is written
Live refresh during the demo replay or the pilot
side_effects: Funnel counts on the internal metrics page are recomputed from StatusEvent rows
Each stage shows the number of distinct listings that reached it
error_handling: If a listing has no StatusEvent for a stage it is counted as not reaching that stage, never inferred
If a StatusEvent has a missing timestamp it is excluded from time-based metrics and flagged for review
If the metrics query fails, the page shows the last successful snapshot with its time stamped

business_rules.name: rescue_rate_counts_delivered_before_deadline
business_rules.description: Rescue rate is the number of listings whose StatusEvent shows delivered before the listing's consume-by deadline, divided by the number of listings posted, with a target of 70% or more.
triggers: Admin opens the internal metrics page
Weekly metrics snapshot is taken
Demo day replay completes
side_effects: Rescue rate is shown against the 70% target on the internal metrics page
A rate below target is highlighted for the product owner
error_handling: If no listings have been posted in the window the rate is shown as not applicable, not zero
A delivered event recorded after the consume-by time does not count toward the rescue rate
Listings still open at the window end are excluded from the denominator until they reach a final status

business_rules.name: expiry_rate_counts_expired_over_posted
business_rules.description: Expiry rate is the number of listings with an expired StatusEvent divided by the number of listings posted, with a target under 20%.
triggers: Admin opens the internal metrics page
Weekly metrics snapshot is taken
Auto-expiry at a consume-by deadline writes a status change
side_effects: Expiry rate is shown against the under-20% target on the internal metrics page
A rate at or above target is flagged for the go/no-go review
error_handling: Expiry written by the system actor is counted the same as expiry by a person
If no listings have been posted in the window the rate is shown as not applicable
Duplicate expired events for one listing are counted once

business_rules.name: time_to_post_and_claim_medians_from_event_timestamps
business_rules.description: Time to post is the median time from post started to posted, and time to claim is the median time from posted to claimed, both computed from StatusEvent timestamps against targets of 60 seconds and 15 minutes.
triggers: Admin opens the internal metrics page
A listing is claimed or posted during the replay or pilot
side_effects: Median time to post and median time to claim are displayed next to their targets
Baseline values stay labelled as assumptions until replaced by interview findings
error_handling: A listing with a claim but no posted event is excluded from time to claim
Negative durations caused by clock or ordering errors are excluded and logged
With fewer than five samples the median is shown with a low-sample warning

business_rules.name: impact_metrics_exclude_expired_and_cancelled_listings
business_rules.description: Any impact figure shown alongside funnel metrics counts only delivered listings, so expired and cancelled listings never add to meals, kg or CO2e.
triggers: Admin opens the internal metrics page
A listing reaches Expired or Cancelled status
side_effects: Impact totals on the metrics page sum only delivered listings
Each impact total shows the assumption version it used
error_handling: An ImpactRecord whose listing is later expired is excluded from the totals
If an impact record has no assumption version it is excluded and flagged

business_rules.name: metrics_page_restricted_to_platform_admin
business_rules.description: Only a user with the platform admin role can view the internal metrics page, since it exposes all funnel and performance figures across donors and receivers.
triggers: A user requests the internal metrics page
A role switch occurs during the demo
side_effects: Non-admin users are shown a not-permitted message instead of the metrics
The access attempt is recorded
error_handling: A request without a valid role returns the not-permitted message
A denied access attempt does not reveal any metric values

steps.description: Usage page shows daily token usage and cost against the budget with the 70% alert.

business_rules.name: token_budget_alert_at_70_percent
business_rules.description: When cumulative token usage from the anthropic (ai) integration reaches 70% of the token budget, the usage page shows a budget alert to the product owner.
triggers: Admin opens the usage page
Daily token usage total is recalculated
Token usage crosses the 70% threshold during the day
side_effects: The usage page displays a warning that the token budget has reached 70%
The product owner is alerted that AI features may stop if the budget runs out
error_handling: If token usage data is unavailable, the page shows that usage cannot be read and does not show a false 0% reading
If the budget is not configured, the page shows that no budget is set and no alert fires

business_rules.name: token_cost_calculated_from_tokens_and_model_price
business_rules.description: Estimated cost for a period equals total tokens divided by 1,000,000 multiplied by the model's blended price per million tokens, shown against the budget.
triggers: Admin opens the usage page
Daily totals are recalculated
side_effects: The usage page shows daily token usage and estimated cost next to the budget
error_handling: If the model price is not yet confirmed, the page shows token counts only and labels cost as unavailable

steps.description: Admin monitors status changes across all listings on the live board.

business_rules.name: every_listing_status_change_is_logged
business_rules.description: Every change of a listing's status is recorded as a StatusEvent with the from state, the to state, the actor and the timestamp, so the live board and audit trail reflect the full history.
triggers: A listing moves to a new status (posted, offered, claimed, collected, delivered, expired or cancelled)
The admin opens the live status board and views the event history for a listing
side_effects: A StatusEvent row is written for each transition, naming the listing, the previous state, the new state, the actor who caused it and the time
The admin's live board shows the new status and its event history
error_handling: If a transition cannot be logged, the status change is not applied and the actor is told the change failed
If the actor is unknown (for example a system timer), the event is logged with the system as the actor rather than left blank

business_rules.name: live_board_shows_status_changes_within_5_seconds
business_rules.description: The live status board shows each new StatusEvent and the updated Listing.status for all listings within 5 seconds of the change.
triggers: A new StatusEvent is recorded for any listing
The admin has the live status board open
side_effects: The admin sees the listing's new status and the new event on the board without reloading the page
Listings whose status changes move to the correct group on the board
error_handling: If the live update connection drops, the board shows a stale-data warning and refreshes the list on reconnect
If a status event arrives out of order, the board orders events by created_at and shows the latest Listing.status

business_rules.name: listing_status_moves_only_along_the_allowed_lifecycle
business_rules.description: A listing's status moves only along the allowed path: posted → offered → claimed → collected → delivered, with claimed → posted on receiver cancel, posted → cancelled by donor, claimed → cancelled by donor, and any unclaimed or undelivered listing → expired at its deadline; delivered is reached only through a claim.
triggers: A receiver claims an offer, a volunteer collects, or a receiver confirms delivery
A receiver cancels a claim or a donor cancels a listing
The deadline passes on an unclaimed or undelivered listing
side_effects: Listing.status changes to the next allowed state and a StatusEvent is written
Any transition not on the allowed path is refused and no StatusEvent is written for it
error_handling: If a status update would skip a state (for example posted → delivered), the change is refused and the board shows the rejected attempt as an error
If a second receiver tries to claim an already claimed listing, the update is refused and the receiver sees 'already claimed'

business_rules.name: unclaimed_or_undelivered_listing_expires_at_consume_by_deadline
business_rules.description: When Listing.consume_by_at passes while the listing is still posted, offered, claimed or collected without delivery, the listing moves to expired and an event is logged.
triggers: The consume-by time on a listing is reached
The server checks deadlines, including after a restart
side_effects: Listing.status becomes expired and a StatusEvent records the change with the system as actor
The donor, the receiver and any assigned volunteer are told the listing expired
The admin's live board moves the listing into the expired group
error_handling: If the server was down past the deadline, the expiry is applied on start-up from the database
If a delivery is confirmed at the same moment as the deadline, the listing is delivered only if the delivery was recorded before the deadline

business_rules.name: admin_board_is_read_only_for_listing_status
business_rules.description: The admin's live status board displays listing status and events but does not allow the admin to change a listing's status or edit a StatusEvent.
triggers: The admin views the live status board
The admin selects a listing or event on the board
side_effects: No status changes are made by viewing the board
Status events remain as originally recorded
error_handling: If a status change request reaches the board's data path, it is refused and logged as an unauthorised attempt

name: Account Profile Update and Sign Out
description: Any signed-in user checks or updates their own details, such as a volunteer's availability and vehicle, and signs out.

steps.description: User signs in with their role.

business_rules.name: demo_role_switcher_selects_session_role
business_rules.description: The login page lets the user choose one role (donor, receiver, volunteer, sponsor or admin) and the session takes on that role for the demo, with no password check in the MVP.
triggers: User opens the login page
User selects a role and confirms it
side_effects: User.role is set to the chosen role for this session
User is taken to the home view for that role (caterer manager, receiver, volunteer, sponsor or admin)
error_handling: No role selected: confirmation is blocked and the user is asked to choose a role
Role value outside the five allowed roles: the choice is rejected and the user is asked to pick again

business_rules.name: role_switcher_is_not_authentication
business_rules.description: Choosing a role on the login page does not verify identity; real sign-in and receiver verification are deferred to the hardening and later phases.
triggers: User confirms a role on the login page
side_effects: Session is marked as demo-only, so any role can be chosen without proof of identity
Role-based access to donor posting still depends on the FSSAI verification rule (FR-17) applied when the user posts
error_handling: Attempt to reach a protected view without a chosen role: user is sent back to the login page

business_rules.name: admin_role_limited_to_platform_owner
business_rules.description: The admin role gives access to assumption and flagging tools and is used in the MVP only by the product owner.
triggers: User selects the admin role on the login page
side_effects: Session gets admin capabilities such as reviewing flagged listings and maintaining assumption values
error_handling: Admin role not offered to non-owner users in the pilot build: selection is hidden or rejected

validation_rules.description: A role must be selected before the user can continue to the role's view.
validation_rules.error_message: Choose a role to continue.

validation_rules.description: The role must be one of the allowed values: donor, receiver, volunteer, sponsor or admin.
validation_rules.error_message: Pick one of the listed roles.

steps.description: Volunteer updates availability windows and vehicle; other roles update their own details.

business_rules.name: volunteer_availability_windows_limit_task_offers
business_rules.description: A volunteer's saved availability windows determine when they can be offered pickups, so offers and escalations go only to volunteers free in the required time.
triggers: Volunteer saves changes to availability windows on the profile
Matching or escalation looks for a volunteer for a pickup
side_effects: Volunteer.availability_windows is replaced with the saved windows
Pickups outside those windows are not offered to the volunteer
Volunteer is included in offers only when a pickup falls inside a saved window
error_handling: No availability windows saved: volunteer receives no pickup offers until at least one window is added
Window overlaps another window on the same day: merged or rejected before saving
No volunteer free in the window during escalation: the listing moves to the donor drop-off or receiver collection path

business_rules.name: volunteer_vehicle_used_in_assignment
business_rules.description: A volunteer's vehicle type (two-wheeler or car) is stored on the profile and used when assigning pickups and ranking volunteers for a listing.
triggers: Volunteer saves a vehicle type on the profile
Matching or reassignment selects a volunteer for a claimed listing
side_effects: Volunteer.vehicle_type is updated to the chosen vehicle
Assignment and ETA for future pickups use the new vehicle type
The assigned volunteer sees the vehicle type that will be used for the pickup
error_handling: No vehicle type selected: profile cannot be saved
Vehicle changed while a pickup is already assigned: existing assignment keeps its ETA and the change applies to future assignments only

business_rules.name: volunteer_location_stored_as_zone_only
business_rules.description: A volunteer's location is kept as one of the eight launch zones on the profile, never as a street address, and the exact pickup point is revealed only to the assigned volunteer.
triggers: Volunteer edits the profile location
Volunteer views the profile after saving
side_effects: Volunteer.zone is set to a launch zone ID with jittered coordinates
No street address is stored on the volunteer profile
error_handling: Free-text address entered: rejected and the volunteer is asked to choose a zone
Zone outside the launch zones: rejected with a message that the zone is not yet served

business_rules.name: users_edit_only_their_own_profile
business_rules.description: Each signed-in role can change only its own profile details, and the saved changes belong to that user's record.
triggers: Any role opens the profile page and saves changes
A profile save request is received
side_effects: User.display_name and User.contact are updated for the signed-in user only
User.role is not changed by profile edits
error_handling: Attempt to change another user's profile: request refused and not stored
Attempt to change the role through the profile: ignored and the role stays the same

business_rules.name: contact_stored_masked
business_rules.description: A user's contact number is stored and displayed in masked form, with the full number kept only in the protected record.
triggers: User saves a contact number on the profile
Profile is displayed to any party
side_effects: User.contact is stored masked for display
Other parties see only the masked contact
error_handling: Contact number not in a valid format: profile not saved and the user is told the format needed
Contact missing for a donor or receiver: profile saved but the user is reminded to add one before posting or accepting

business_rules.name: donor_fssai_change_requires_reverification
business_rules.description: Changing a donor's FSSAI licence or registration number resets its verified status until the new number passes the check, and posting is blocked in the meantime.
triggers: Donor saves a new FSSAI licence or registration number on the profile
side_effects: Donor.fssai_verified is set to false on change
The mocked FSSAI check runs on the new number
Donor.fssai_verified becomes true only if the check passes
The donor is shown the 'FSSAI-verified donor' badge only after verification
error_handling: New number fails the check: posting stays blocked and the donor is told the reason
Number expired: posting paused the same day and the donor is told to renew

validation_rules.description: At least one availability window must be given before the volunteer can receive pickup offers.
validation_rules.error_message: Add at least one time window when you are free to help.

validation_rules.description: Each availability window's start time must be earlier than its end time, and the window must fall within a single day.
validation_rules.error_message: End time must be after start time, within the same day.

validation_rules.description: Vehicle type must be chosen as either two-wheeler or car.
validation_rules.error_message: Choose your vehicle: two-wheeler or car.

validation_rules.description: Zone must be one of the eight launch zones and cannot be a free-text street address.
validation_rules.error_message: Choose one of the launch zones. Street addresses are not stored.

validation_rules.description: Display name is 2 to 60 characters long.
validation_rules.error_message: Name must be between 2 and 60 characters.

validation_rules.description: Contact must be a 10-digit mobile number, and it is stored masked after saving.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter a valid 10-digit mobile number.

validation_rules.description: FSSAI licence or registration number must be 14 digits and is checked before posting is allowed.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter the 14-digit FSSAI licence or registration number.

steps.description: User signs out from the profile.

business_rules.name: sign_out_does_not_stop_open_rescues
business_rules.description: Signing out ends only the user's session; listings, offers and deadlines continue to run server-side while the user is away.
triggers: User selects sign out on the profile page
A listing has an open offer or an active claim when the user signs out
side_effects: User.session_ended_at is recorded and the user's session is closed
Listing.status is unchanged by the sign out
Offer timeouts, the 15-minute escalation and the consume-by expiry keep running on the server
error_handling: If session closure fails, the user is kept on the profile page with a plain message and no listing or offer is altered
If a deadline passes while the user is signed out, the listing expires as normal and the affected parties are notified on their next visit

business_rules.name: sign_out_clears_active_role
business_rules.description: Signing out clears the active role on the User record so the next person starts from the role switcher, not in the previous user's role.
triggers: User selects sign out on the profile page
side_effects: User.active_role is cleared
The next visitor sees the role switcher and must choose a role before acting
error_handling: If the role cannot be cleared, the session is still closed and the role is cleared on the next load

business_rules.name: sign_out_is_recorded_for_audit
business_rules.description: Each sign out is logged against the user with the time, so the audit trail shows who was active when a status change or agent decision happened.
triggers: User selects sign out on the profile page
side_effects: A sign-out entry with time and user identity is written to the audit log
error_handling: If the audit entry cannot be written, sign out still completes and the failure is logged for the product owner

name: Intake Falls Back to Plain Form When AI Fails
description: When the LLM is slow or returns invalid output, the donor is shown the plain 3-field form with allergens marked unknown, and posting still works without AI.

steps.description: Donor types a free-text post on the post page.

business_rules.name: ai_drafts_listing_fields_from_free_text
business_rules.description: The donor's free-text post is sent to the Anthropic model, which extracts items, quantities and pickup-by time into a draft Listing that the donor must confirm before it is posted.
triggers: Donor submits the free-text post on the post page
side_effects: Listing.raw_text keeps the donor's original words
Extracted fields are stored as an unconfirmed draft with Listing.status still before Posted
Each extracted field is marked AI-filled until the donor confirms it
Listing.intake_source is set to ai
error_handling: If the Anthropic call takes longer than 5 seconds, the donor is moved to the plain form
If the output is invalid, one retry is made before the donor is moved to the plain form
If the donor has not confirmed the draft, no Listing reaches Posted

business_rules.name: ai_never_invents_quantities_or_allergens
business_rules.description: The extraction must leave quantities, pickup-by time and allergens empty when the post does not state them, and must ask at most one follow-up question for a missing required field.
triggers: Extraction completes on a post with a missing or ambiguous quantity, time or allergen
side_effects: Listing.allergens is set to 'unknown — ask donor' when the post does not name allergens
The donor is asked one follow-up question for the first missing required field, with pickup-by time asked first
No quantity or time is filled in unless the donor's text states it
error_handling: If the model returns a quantity or allergen not found in the text or the food-to-allergen map, the value is discarded and the field is left empty
If more than one field is missing, only one question is asked and the rest stay empty for the donor to complete

business_rules.name: intake_falls_back_to_plain_form_when_ai_fails
business_rules.description: When the AI is slow or returns invalid output after one retry, the donor is switched to the plain 3-field form and the typed text is kept, so posting never depends on the AI.
triggers: Anthropic call exceeds 5 seconds
Anthropic returns invalid output on the first attempt and again on the retry
side_effects: Listing.intake_source is set to form
The donor sees the plain 3-field form with the original text preserved
Listing.raw_text is kept for the audit log
error_handling: If the form also cannot be shown, the donor's typed text is saved so nothing is lost
Every fallback is logged with time, actor and the AI output for review

business_rules.name: unverified_donor_cannot_post
business_rules.description: Only donors with a verified FSSAI licence or registration number may create a listing, and an expired, unverified or mismatched number blocks the post page before any AI call.
triggers: Donor opens the post page
Donor submits the free-text post
side_effects: No Listing is created for an unverified donor
The donor is shown the reason the posting is blocked
The Anthropic model is not called
error_handling: If the FSSAI check is unavailable, posting is blocked and the donor is told the check could not be completed
If the licence expires during a session, the next submission is blocked

business_rules.name: listing_must_be_in_launch_zone
business_rules.description: A post is accepted only when the donor's zone is one of the eight Bhubaneswar launch zones, and a donor outside them is blocked with a clear message.
triggers: Donor submits the free-text post
side_effects: No Listing is created for a donor outside the launch zones
The donor is told posting is not yet available in their area
error_handling: If the zone is missing, posting is blocked until a launch zone is set on the donor's account

business_rules.name: ai_output_with_banned_claim_or_injection_discarded
business_rules.description: Any model output that contains a banned claim (such as safe, certified, tax benefit) or follows an injected instruction is discarded and the donor is moved to the plain form.
triggers: Anthropic output contains a banned word or claim
Donor text contains an instruction that tries to change the rules
side_effects: Extracted draft fields from the model are discarded
Listing.intake_source is set to form
The case is logged for the admin
error_handling: The donor sees the plain form with the original text preserved
The admin is alerted with the case for review and a new golden case is added

business_rules.name: pickup_by_too_soon_marks_listing_unrescuable
business_rules.description: A post whose pickup-by time has already passed or is under 30 minutes away is marked unrescuable with a reason and is not offered to receivers.
triggers: Extraction or form submission sets Listing.pickup_by_at
side_effects: Listing.rescuable becomes false with the reason stored
The donor is told why the food cannot be offered
error_handling: If the pickup-by time is missing, the listing is held until the donor supplies it

validation_rules.description: The free-text post must not be empty or only spaces before the donor submits it.
validation_rules.error_message: Describe the food you have to donate, for example: 40 plates veg biryani, pickup by 11:30.

validation_rules.description: The free-text post is between 1 and 1000 characters after trimming whitespace.
validation_rules.error_message: Keep your post under 1000 characters. Shorten it and try again.

steps.description: LLM call exceeds 5 s or returns invalid output; the service retries once.

business_rules.name: intake_falls_back_to_plain_form_when_llm_fails
business_rules.description: If the intake LLM call takes longer than 5 seconds or returns invalid output after one retry, the donor is shown the plain 3-field form (what food, how much, pickup-by time) and no AI-extracted listing is produced.
triggers: Intake LLM call exceeds 5 seconds
Intake LLM call returns output that fails the listing schema after the single retry
Intake LLM call returns text containing a banned claim or injected instruction after the retry
side_effects: The donor is shown the plain 3-field form in place of the AI-filled confirmation screen
Listing.status stays unposted (draft) until the donor completes the form
The donor's typed text is kept so the donor can re-enter it into the form
The failed AI attempt is logged with its time, inputs and outputs
error_handling: LLM timeout over 5 seconds: retry once, then show the plain form
Invalid JSON or schema mismatch after retry: show the plain form and log the attempt
Banned claim or injection detected in output: discard the output, log the case, show the plain form, and tell the admin
Donor sees a plain message that AI assistance is unavailable and the form can be filled in by hand

business_rules.name: llm_intake_retried_exactly_once
business_rules.description: A failed or invalid intake LLM response is retried a single time before the fallback is used, so the donor waits no longer than the 5-second limit allows.
triggers: First intake LLM call times out or returns invalid output
side_effects: A second LLM call is made with the same donor input
If the second call also fails, the plain form is shown
error_handling: Retry also fails: fall back to the plain form with no further attempts
Retry succeeds: continue with the AI-extracted draft for donor confirmation

business_rules.name: unknown_allergens_default_to_ask_donor_on_fallback
business_rules.description: When the AI intake fails, Listing.allergens is set to "unknown — ask donor" and is never assumed to be absent.
triggers: Intake falls back to the plain form
Donor leaves the allergens field blank on the plain form
side_effects: Listing.allergens holds "unknown — ask donor" until the donor enters allergen information
The receiver sees allergens as unknown on the handling card
error_handling: Donor submits without allergen input: keep the value as unknown and allow posting only after donor confirmation
Donor later enters allergens: replace the unknown value with the entered tags

business_rules.name: ai_draft_never_posted_without_donor_confirmation
business_rules.description: No listing reaches Posted from the fallback path until the donor has reviewed and confirmed the items, quantities and pickup-by time themselves.
triggers: Donor submits the plain form after an AI failure
Donor confirms the listing on the confirmation screen
side_effects: Listing.status moves from draft to Posted only after donor confirmation
A StatusEvent is recorded with the donor as actor
error_handling: Donor abandons the form before confirming: listing stays draft and nothing is offered
Donor confirmation missing: block the move to Posted

business_rules.name: consume_by_deadline_still_computed_on_fallback
business_rules.description: On the plain-form fallback, Listing.consume_by is still computed by code as the earlier of the donor's pickup-by time and the rule-table limit, so the deadline is protected without AI.
triggers: Donor submits the plain form after an AI failure
side_effects: Listing.consume_by is set from the rule table and the entered pickup-by time
Listing is marked unrescuable if the deadline is under 30 minutes away
error_handling: Pickup-by time already passed or under 30 minutes away: block offering and tell the donor why
Rule-table lookup unavailable: use the most conservative limit and label it as such

business_rules.name: ai_outage_does_not_block_posting
business_rules.description: Posting is always possible through the plain form, so an AI failure never prevents a donor from completing a listing.
triggers: Intake LLM is unavailable, slow or invalid
Donor starts a post
side_effects: Listing can reach Posted through the plain form with the same handling card and deadline rules
error_handling: Plain form submission fails validation: show the field-level message and keep the donor's entries

steps.description: Donor is shown the plain 3-field form; allergens are marked 'unknown — ask donor'.

business_rules.name: intake_falls_back_to_plain_form_when_ai_fails
business_rules.description: If the AI intake call takes longer than 5 seconds, or returns invalid output after one retry, the donor is shown the plain 3-field form and the listing continues without AI.
triggers: Anthropic intake parsing call exceeds 5 seconds
Anthropic intake parsing returns output that fails the schema after one retry
Donor submits a free-text post and the AI service is unavailable
side_effects: Listing.intake_source is set to plain_form
the donor sees the 3-field form (food, how much, pickup-by time) with any AI-extracted values cleared
the AI failure and the fallback are logged with time and inputs
error_handling: AI times out at 5 seconds: discard any partial output and show the plain form
Invalid AI output after one retry: discard the output and show the plain form
AI returns a banned claim or injected instruction: discard the output, log the case, show the plain form, and notify the admin

business_rules.name: allergens_default_to_unknown_never_assumed_absent
business_rules.description: When the plain form is used, Listing.allergens is set to 'unknown — ask donor' and is never assumed absent or guessed.
triggers: Donor reaches the plain 3-field form after AI fallback
Donor posts through the plain form without declaring allergens
side_effects: Listing.allergens is set to 'unknown — ask donor'
the receiver sees allergens shown as unknown on the handling card
error_handling: If any allergen value other than 'unknown — ask donor' is produced without donor input, the listing is not posted and the value is reset to unknown

business_rules.name: plain_form_listing_requires_donor_confirmation_before_posting
business_rules.description: A listing created on the plain form moves to Posted only after the donor reviews and confirms the entered food, quantity and pickup-by time.
triggers: Donor submits the plain 3-field form
Donor taps confirm on the confirmation screen
side_effects: Listing.status moves from draft to Posted only after donor confirmation
a status change to Posted is logged with time and actor
error_handling: Donor leaves the confirmation screen without confirming: listing stays in draft and is not offered
Required field missing at confirmation: donor is shown the error and fixes it before posting

business_rules.name: plain_form_listing_still_requires_fssai_donor_and_time_limits
business_rules.description: A listing created on the plain form is blocked unless the donor has a verified FSSAI licence or registration, and its pickup-by time must be at least 30 minutes away before it can be posted.
triggers: Donor submits the plain 3-field form
Donor's FSSAI verification is checked at posting
side_effects: if the FSSAI check fails, Listing.status stays draft and the donor sees the reason
if pickup-by is under 30 minutes away, Listing.status is set to unrescuable and the donor is told why
error_handling: Unverified, expired or mismatched FSSAI number: posting blocked with a clear reason
Pickup-by already passed or under 30 minutes away: listing not offered and marked unrescuable

validation_rules.error_message: Pickup-by time must be at least 30 minutes from now.

business_rules.name: donor_must_confirm_listing_before_posting
business_rules.description: A listing moves from draft to Posted only after the donor has reviewed and confirmed every extracted field, so AI suggestions never post without a person's approval.
triggers: Donor presses confirm on the listing confirmation screen
side_effects: Listing.status becomes Posted (draft → Posted)
Listing.confirmed_at is set to the time of confirmation
Listing.ai_filled_fields is cleared for every field the donor confirmed
A StatusEvent records draft → Posted with the donor as actor
error_handling: Donor leaves any AI-filled field unconfirmed: posting is blocked and the unconfirmed fields are highlighted
Donor closes the screen without confirming: listing stays draft and nothing is offered

business_rules.name: unverified_donor_cannot_post
business_rules.description: Only donors with a verified, unexpired FSSAI licence or registration number can post a listing.
triggers: Donor presses confirm to post a listing
side_effects: Listing.status stays draft when the check fails
The donor is shown the reason posting was blocked
A StatusEvent records the blocked attempt with the donor as actor
error_handling: FSSAI number missing, unverified, expired or mismatched: posting is blocked with a clear reason

business_rules.name: handling_card_required_before_posting
business_rules.description: A listing cannot reach Posted unless it carries a consume-by time, storage guidance, allergen information and the fixed disclaimer.
triggers: Donor presses confirm to post a listing
side_effects: Listing.status becomes Posted only when all four handling card fields are present
Listing.disclaimer is set to the fixed text 'Not certified safe — follow handling guidance'
Listing.allergens is set to 'unknown — ask donor' for any allergen not confirmed
error_handling: Any handling card field missing: posting is blocked and the missing field is named on screen
Allergens not stated: stored as 'unknown — ask donor' and never assumed absent

business_rules.name: consume_by_is_earliest_of_pickup_and_rule_limit
business_rules.description: The consume-by deadline is the earlier of the donor's pickup-by time and the limit from the food-handling rule table for that food type and storage.
triggers: Donor confirms pickup-by time and item details on the confirmation screen
side_effects: Listing.consume_by_at is computed and shown on the confirmation screen
Listing.consume_by_at is stored with the rule table version used
error_handling: Rule table has no entry for the food type: the most conservative limit is applied and labelled as such
Rule table unavailable: the most conservative limit is applied

business_rules.name: listing_too_close_to_deadline_is_unrescuable
business_rules.description: A listing whose consume-by deadline is less than 30 minutes away at posting is marked unrescuable and is not offered to receivers.
triggers: Donor confirms a listing whose pickup-by or consume-by time is already passed or under 30 minutes away
side_effects: Listing.is_rescuable is set to false
Listing is not offered to any receiver
The donor is told why the listing cannot be rescued
error_handling: Pickup-by time in the past: posting is refused with the reason and the donor is asked to correct the time

business_rules.name: listing_must_be_in_launch_zone
business_rules.description: A donor outside the eight launch zones cannot post, and each listing is tied to one zone ID.
triggers: Donor confirms a listing with a zone selection
side_effects: Listing.zone_id is stored as a zone ID, not an address
Listing.status stays draft when the zone is outside the launch zones
error_handling: Zone outside Patia, Chandrasekharpur, Saheed Nagar, Nayapalli, Jaydev Vihar, Khandagiri, Old Town or Rasulgarh: posting is blocked with a clear message

business_rules.name: possible_duplicate_listing_requires_confirmation
business_rules.description: If the same donor posts the same items within 10 minutes of an earlier listing, the donor must confirm before a second listing is created.
triggers: Donor confirms a listing whose donor and items match a listing created within the last 10 minutes
side_effects: Listing stays draft until the donor confirms it is a separate listing
The earlier listing is left unchanged
error_handling: Donor cancels the duplicate: the draft is discarded and no second listing is created

business_rules.name: ai_failure_falls_back_to_plain_form
business_rules.description: If the AI extraction is down, slow beyond 5 seconds, or returns invalid output after one retry, the donor sees the plain three-field form and posting proceeds without AI.
triggers: AI extraction call times out after 5 seconds
AI returns output that fails the schema after one retry
side_effects: Donor is shown the plain three-field form with the values entered so far
Listing.ai_filled_fields is left empty

error_handling: AI returns a banned claim or injected instruction: output discarded, case logged, plain form used, and the admin is notified

business_rules.name: donor_sees_ai_source_for_each_field
business_rules.description: Every AI-filled field on the confirmation screen shows the original text or transcript and is marked 'AI-filled' until the donor confirms it.
triggers: Donor opens the confirmation screen for a listing created from free text or voice
side_effects: Each AI-filled field is highlighted with the words it came from
Each field's AI-filled marker is cleared when the donor confirms it
error_handling: Source text missing for a field: the field is shown as 'AI-filled, no source' and must be confirmed or edited

business_rules.name: post_creates_audit_trail
business_rules.description: Each confirmed post creates a timestamped StatusEvent recording the move from draft to Posted, with the donor as actor.
triggers: Listing moves from draft to Posted
side_effects: A StatusEvent records draft → Posted with time and actor
The post-started and listing-posted timings become measurable for the time-to-post metric
error_handling: Status event write fails: the post is rolled back so no Posted listing exists without its event
